name: Bio Energy Communication
description: The user will have the ability to change their bio-energy into frequencies that they can us to communicate with other living things. With time, they will be able to gain new uses for this power like using those frequencies on one target and cause headaches, vertigo, or death. You can manipulate sound through your frequencies to enhance or weaken them.

strengths: Communicate with other living things
Manipulate sounds
Create frequencies with different effects

Can be disrupted with a large amount of concentrated radio waves.

name: Energy Manipulation/Control
description: Most Energywielders are separated into light and dark. LightWielders can naturaly flow energy through their bodies quickly and continuously but weak in power. DarkWielders can collect and focus energy and release it in precise and powerful blasts but cant be fired quickly. Their specializations do not make them good or evil. strengths: Power over many types of energy
Can be used in creative ways
Can be pulled from anywhere(no need of a source)

Not all types of energy are effective against all enemies

name: Psionic Energy Manipulation
description: This ability is, basically, the psychic equivalent of induced radioactivity. A person can absorb limitless amounts of psionic energy without harm, and emit it at will in small amounts or in a huge blast similar to a shockwave from a supersonic jet. You can even control bursts of energy in your hands, similar to small atomic explosions, like what someone with induced radioactivity could do.
summary: The ability to absorb and emit powerful psionic energy at will from both the mind AND the body
strengths: No psychic could ever hope to read your mind or control you!
Your power is great in a fight!
You could eventually develop psychic powers with enough practice!
weaknesses: Psionic energy bursts can be lethal to others
Extreme levels of power can fatigue you very quickly, and gradually weaken your power

name: Tactile Superpower Creation
description: This ability allows one to use material/Living thing and give it a different use.  The limit is the user's creativity, and what kind of material or thing it is?  Example, The user was holding a #2 pencil. Now, he can turn it in to an ability like Lead beam, wood bombs, or even a combination. If a user touches another super-being, they can use their abilities as well.

strengths: Create new powers
Take control of anything and make them useful
Use another super being's abilities
weaknesses: Limited by user's creativity
Limited by what kind of material/ living thing it is
Must be able to touch something

name: Magno Solar Absorption
description: This ability allows you to absorb the sun's energy, and the energy of it's magnetic field, through UV exposure. You can store that energy in your mind and body indefinitely without harm, and emit it at will to create magnetic fields, fireballs, ultraviolet rays for weaponry, and also heat generation.
summary: The ability to absorb the energy and magnetism of the sun for a weapon

You can control vast levels of magnetic energy for any desired use, even to fly!
You can develop other powers such as pyrokinesis with time and practice

With it, you can create lightning that is controlled by your mind and/or your willpower. You can create electrical balls, bolts, arcs, and almost anything else related to them. There is no limit to the control time of this power.

strengths: You are naturally immune to your power, even when in contact with water or metal.
Is extremely powerful.
Can be learned and controlled in a very short amount of time.
weaknesses: Strong negative emotions can sometimes make you lose control.

strengths: Powerful attack
Decent defense
Immoblizes opponents or any object

description: As an electrophite, you will be able to harness the power of electricity. You will be able to direct it and manipulate it to your will. With time, as your powers develop, you will be able to create electricity from nothing and eventually travel as electricity. You can even travel through power lines and outlets. Unfortunately, this power takes a long time to control, but a relatively short time to develop

strengths: You can harness and eventually create electricity
Lightning fast travel
Most of the world has electricity to harness

Anything touched by your electricity will most likely die, even loved ones

name: Pure Energy
description: With your hands, you have full control over direction. If you can't use your hands for some reason, then use your eyes. If you want to blast in all directions, use your entire body. You can use this energy as a shield or a platform of energy for transportation. How this energy is looks is pretty much your choice (transparant, translucent, solid, and color choice). But, to blast any energy at all, you must use 100% concentration.

strengths: Can blast energy from hands, eyes, and/or entire body
Pure energy
weaknesses: Requires 100% concentration, nothing less

strengths: You are immune to harmful radiation

weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Infinite Energy Storage
description: With this ability, you can store an infinite amount of energy inside of yourself. With practice, you can control how much of that energy you use. You can still get hurt from energy based attacks.
You need practice to control the amount of energy used.

name: Soul Weapons
description: Everyone's soul is different. So, with this power, you will have the perfect personalized melee weapon based off of your soul. The weapon will reflect the soul of the person. If you are a good person, it will have a bright aura. If you are evil, it will pulse with darkness. The weapon will always feel balanced and right in the user's arms. The weapon is perfectly balanced to the person and unbreakable
The weapon is created based off of the person's soul
weaknesses: The weapon will always be the same. It will never change based on needs, lifestyle, etc.
Good people are damaged by evil weapons and evil people are more damaged by good weapons(also a pro)

strengths: The bigger the energy source, the greater the power
Almost anything around you can be used as energy
weaknesses: The smaller the energy source, lesser the power
Energy cannot be created
Energy-Suppressing abilities

name: Electrical Storm
description: Absorb electricity from around you, e.g. power lines or living creatures. You can use it to zap enemies or use its electrical vibrations to move objects around. Cannot be constant

name: Plasma Control
description: With the ability to control matter made up of a high amount of energy, or plasma, you would essentially become a very powerful being. Plasma is the least common form of matter on earth, but it is actually the most common of all the universe. Such examples are stars, auroras, and nebulas. Create high energy objects such as lightning.

name: Mirror Teleport
description: Imagine you are surrounded by hundreds of soldiers or a few other superheroes and you're about to get the beating of your lifetime. name: Energy Form

Depending on how much of your energy you direct at the symbol the longer your power will last.

This is done by warping the reality of that thing without changing much of it's physical existence.  For example, changing the purpose of a venus flytrap from catching insects into store energy. Another example would be to giving a person the purpose of being your minion. This effect only last for several hours or more.

strengths: Potential to live forever.

Great for self-defense
Powerful ability

Go for a walk in the sun and charge your electronics.
Charge other powers.

name: Energizer Bunny

summary: The ability to produce luminous energy blasts of plasma and augment your strength by absorbing heat and radiation.
strengths: Explode into a nova and quickly draw yourself back together.
Travel at lightspeed and send enemies packing with "nova punches"
Cannot gain cancer from radiation.
weaknesses: Nova explosions around civilians. (need I say more? )

name: Interruption Inducement
description: This ability allows a user induce interruptions. Example, if you were about to be blasted by someone's energy attack, this ability can interrupt that by any means necessary before the attack is made, may it be a tree falling on the attacker or reality changing. The inducement can change into materializing when needed. This is a passive ability most of the time, but if you master it, you have a good chance to activate it when you focus.
summary: The ability to induce, cause, or materialize anything with the purpose to interrupt anything.
strengths: Interrupt any attack
Interrupt any process or progress
Interrupt any unwanted conversation
weaknesses: Might be interrupted by your own ability at times, if you don't master it.

name: Superhuman Ingenuity
description: What would you do if stuck in a kitchen with heat-seeking death robots? Well, if you had Superhuman Ingenuity, you would light some paper, stick it to the robots with fridge magnets, and leave. People with this ability can see the connections between objects in a subconscious way. So in a situation, they can combine an aerosol and a lighter(a torch), or a sock and bar of soap(a flail), or cayenne pepper, vinegar, and baking soda(some tear gas)without even thinking. MacGyver would be proud.
summary: The ability to have superhuman skill in devising solutions to problems
strengths: Never be at a loss
Everything is a weapon
Impress people by fixing their car with a dozen eggs
weaknesses: No other superhuman attributes
May be bugged by needy people
May be tempted to use abilities for mischief

name: Aura Powers
description: Everybody has an aura surrounding them, this ability allows you to use it as a blast of energy and the ability to heal others, and to float/fly by repelling the aura around you (kinda like a magnet repels like poles). Also, you can use it as a form of a weak telekinetic attack by repelling the person's aura hard enough.
summary: The ability to use your human aura as energy to attack and/or heal others.
strengths: The blast of energy can create heat or have charecteristics of fire.
The blast of energy can also freeze things or have characteristics of a freezing power.
You can heal people and yourself quickly by "healing the aura." Also, you can fly by repelling auras
weaknesses: It's more for the "hero" type, so if you use your power for evil you might not like it.
You cannot instantly heal someone. It takes about a half hour to completely heal someone,

name: Lightning
description:
A person with Lightning is a living dynamo. Their abilities include:
*Generating lightning bolts
*Recharging appliances
*Producing an EMP
*Releasing a massive electric shockwave
summary: The ability to produce electricity
strengths: Recharge your iPod whenever
Defy authority
Protect what you love with little effort
weaknesses: Still affected by electricity
If you're wet, your bolts will shock you
Lightning is drawn to metal

name: Plasma Heart
description: Your heart has been replaced with an alien heart that pumps plasma-charged blood around your body. As a result of this, you can phase the plasma through your veins to create plasma blasts, beams or shields. It also allows the electric energy in the plasma to escape and let you glide when jumping, like an electromagnetic pulse.
summary: The ability to generate plasma shields, beams and orbs
strengths: Plasma powers
Gliding when jumping from great height
Improved healing factor
weaknesses: Dangerous when fired at people, it can cause burns or worse.
Time is needed to recharge after expelling large amounts of plasma
Alien hearts can cause side effects

name: Viral Blast
description: Power from the black arts. The user can throw viral energy blasts from his hands. When the blast touches a target, he becomes sick and dies within 3 hours if not healed by a healing power or magic. If the target has powers, he can resist up to 6 hours, but s/he also dies if not healed by healing powers or by magic.
summary: The ability to throw a viral energy blast that slowly kills
strengths: Kills pretty much everything in a sick way
User may choose the potency of the poison in his blasts
It could wear down/defeat stronger opponents
weaknesses: You are not immune so if it's reflected, you die
May only fire up to 50 ft
Drains the user's life force if used too often in a short period

name: Solar Manipulation
description: With this ability, you are able to manipulate and use solar energy, a common resource. You can store it for up to 24 hours, and unleash it in the form of a concentrated beam, or a blast around the radius of your body. Another use for this ability would be to supercharge solar-powered devices, for example, a solar panel. This solar energy can also be used as a source of heat in cold areas. Fortunately, you can determine the amount of solar power you can release, ranging from harmless to fatal.
summary: The ability to manipulate and use solar energy.
strengths: Supercharge solar-powered objects.
Release solar energy in concentrated beams, or blasts which are released in your radius.
You may use the solar power as a source of heat, and control the amount of solar energy you release.
weaknesses: You may accidentally release a harmful amount of solar power.
All solar energy that you can't maintain/store is instantly released around you.

name: Concept Beam
description: Here is an example. The user would like to use the concept of order. They will be able to turn that concept into energy and that energy is released into a beam. That beam then becomes an Order Beam. When it hits something, it makes it more predictable or organized. There are many other concepts and ideas that can be used as well.
summary: The ability to turn any concept or idea into an energy beam that applies that concept to a certain extent.
strengths: Powerful energy beam.
weaknesses: The effects don't last long.

name: Sunlight Absorber
description: With this superpower, you can absorb sunlight just like Superman and use it to fuel your energy and give yourself superpowers. You can think of any powers you want.
summary: The ability to absorb sunlight and use it for superpowers
strengths: Can have unlimited energy
Can have any powers you want
weaknesses: Clouds and shade are your weakness

name: Passive Superpower Aura
description: This power enables one to bestow themselves with an incredible ability. This power must be passive, however and affects everyone within 10 meters. However, you can also apply it to certain groups, like all adolescents or all females. A "group" can also include just yourself or just others. You can only give one at a time, but it can be multifaceted and switched immediately. It can also grant negative powers as weaknesses, such as a poison or induced susceptibility to sunlight.
summary: The ability to give yourself and others nearby a passive ability of your choice.
strengths: Great team support ability.
Can be a specialist weapon.
Can target groups.
weaknesses: Only one ability at a time, although it can be multifaceted.
No Con Negation or similar powers can be used on this.
Only passive abilities.

name: Dark Lightning
description: This ability allows you to generate dark energy in the form of black lightning or any color you wish as long as it is dark (no bright colors). You can shoot bolts of pure dark energy at anything, from your hands or eyes or even legs to either destroy or just shock the target depending how much you focus it and the power being used. With practice you could increase your speed using the dark energy. You won't be able to control electricity in any way, only counter it and can still be shocked.
summary: The ability to generate dark energy in the form of lightning
strengths: Become really scary (not sure if that is a good thing)
Never need a weapon again, at least not for fighting
Can increase speed but needs practice
weaknesses: Running out of energy, thus forcing you to draw more power than you can handle wich could backfire
This is not electrokinesis so you won't be able to control electricity and are not immune to it

name: Sage Power
description: This power allows the user to absorb chi from the immediate surrounding and channeling it to produce energy constructs, blast or Buddhist themed defensive figures that will protect the user
summary: The ability to absorb chi from the surrounding and channeling it.
strengths: Chi is present anywhere
Can go head to head with most powerhouses.
weaknesses: Body of the user is not made invulnerable.
Great control needed to absorb the energy
Will only last a little while, before needing replenishing

name: Chained Lightning
description: The lightning will hit the first target with several volts of electricity and each successive target after that will get half the voltage. The initial amount of electricity depends on the user and how well they have mastered this power. Using this power will drain large amounts of energy from the user.
summary: The ability to fire lightning from one's hand that hits one target then others.
strengths: You can choose how many targets there are and in what order they are hit.
weaknesses: Hitting multiple targets will decrease how harmful this power is on each successive target.

name: Articulation Manipulation
description: With this power, words take on physical actions. For example, saying "Strike" would produce a blast that strikes whatever's in front of you while. "Obey" would make anyone within the soun of your voice obey whatever you say. The problem, however, is that you bound by the rules of language. E.g. if you say "Strike" without thinking of the correct term of voice, you will be struck.
summary: The ability to use words to perform physical action.
strengths: Always win arguments
Never lose debates
weaknesses: If you can't speak, your powers useless
Not using correct form will backfire
Your range is limited to the sound of your voice

name: Light Manipulation
description: With this ability, you can take control of the light surrounding you, or even in dark places, emit light from your hands or body. You can even create floating balls of light. When surrounded with light, you can bend it around you, rendering you with limited invisibility, you can also bend other forms of light such as lasers that would trigger alarms etc. With more practice, you can make your ability offensive, either by creating laser beams from your hands or creating solidified objects of light
summary: The ability to manipulate or generate light
strengths: Natural abundance of light, so theres alot to manipulate
Can become a light source when in need of one
Can turn self or others invisible only through touch
weaknesses: Offensive abilities can be uncontrollable and dangerous
Some light abilities are energy draining and tire the user, such as generating light in darkness
Powers can be overwhelming

name: Umbramaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you can change into a form which grows and gains power from shadows. You transform into a shadow-like monster, and you become more powerful as shadows twist and form around you, increasing your size. As you grow, you gain more and more shadow powers, such as making shadow tentacles, shadow balls, and shadow blasts. If you're powerful enough, physical attacks simply bounce off of you. You are weak to light in this form, and must revert if you take too much damage.
summary: The ability to change into a form which grows and gains power from consuming shadows.
strengths: Gain multiple shadow abilities
If used at night, this can make you almost unstoppable.
If you have consumed enough shadow, physical attacks simply bounce off of you.
weaknesses: If you take in too much light, you become weak and revert. (Ex: Being in the sun)
Once you revert, you start over at normal power when you return to Umbermaniacal Form.
Mental attacks always damage you, regardless of your size or strength.

name: Limits
description: This power bestows you with the ability to unleash at will a series of extremely powerful and devastating ultimate attacks called "Limits. " The Limits that you will have are completely and utterly, cool, awesome, unique, and original too. When you use your Limits, they are signified by a fiery aura that appears over you or your weapons.
summary: The ability to unleash extremely powerful ultimate attacks.
strengths: Have a series of ultimate attacks that are completely and utterly original.
Can control the amount of destructive force your Limits have.
The color of the aura depends upon the user and, as such, is completely random.
weaknesses: Other people, other than what you target, might get hurt.
Your Limits are extremely dangerous, so you have to be careful when you use them.

name: The Hole
description: With this power you can throw anybody you want down a bottomless pit where they will be in a constant state of falling until either they die of shock or starvation or something or you free them. You can also place the pit or move the pit wherever you want. If there is no once currently in the hole it disappears until you want to use it again. You can send multiple people down the hole at once.
summary: The ability to be able to throw anybody you want down a hole
strengths: You can send anybody down a bottomless pit
Only you can free them
You can send multiple people down the pit
weaknesses: If you forget about the person in the pit they could die of starvation

name: Astra Manipulation
description: A great manipulative ability. Very fast, and easily castable. However, it is hard to control due to it being so fast. Can be greatly increased when a violent storm is near. Not useable in a non-electrical area though.
summary: The ability to control lightning and thunder at will.
strengths: Great offencive ability.
Easily createable.
Highly destructive. (For supervillans.)
weaknesses: Could cause shock.
Not good against water.
Difficult to control for beginners

name: Bioenergetic Conversion
description: Bioenergetics is the study of how energy relates to the human anatomy. Normally, people can only absorb chemical energy; a Bioenergetic Converter can metabolize electricity, heat, light, etc. The user does not get stronger, but can use the energy instead of food. Furthermore, they can convert the absorbed power into a more useful form. Chemical energy can become electricity, heat can become light, and so forth. There is of course the issue of unreleased energy gradually becoming fat.
summary: The ability to metabolize, store, and release energy
strengths: Absorb any form of energy
Use metabolized energy instead of food
Convert energy to a more useful form and release it
weaknesses: Cannot operate on reflex
Energy stored for a long time will be made into fat

name: Bioelectrical Bolts
description: A person can use bioelectrical energy from a living being to generate naturally. It can project lightning bolts of up to 10 billion volts. It travels at speed of lightning up to 500,000 feet per second.
summary: The ability to generate and project bolts of bioelectrical lightning
strengths: Can control electronic devices and machines
weaknesses: not effective on rocks

name: Ambient Energy Absorb
description: Your power lets you absorb all the ambient energy around you, like electricity, radiation, light, heat, magnetic fields, etc. and then rechannel that energy elsewhere in your body.  You can redirect it as superhuman strength or speed, invulnerability, or the power even lets you direct the energy back as a compressed beam.
summary: The ability to absorb light, heat, magnetic fields, radiation, etc, and channel it to other areas like strength
strengths: Power source is everywhere
Limitless potential
weaknesses: Your power creates "cold spots" where no ambient energy is
You can short electronics out by absorbing more ambients than they have to give

name: Hyper Revolution
description: The Hyper-Revolution power involves the control of kinetic energy. If you use it on an object, that object will spin at the maximum speed its atoms can withstand. If an object is large enough, its gravitational field will pull in other objects.
summary: The ability to cause things to rotate at max speed.
strengths: Can essentialy create black holes with enough material.
weaknesses: Is contact-based.

name: Neuroburst
description: The Neuroburst power lets the user generate a concentrated electrical pulse inside a target being. This pulse can disable a person's nervous system, leaving them unable to fight. Weaker versions of this power cause pain in the nervous system. It can be long-dstance or contact-based.
summary: The ability to short out a human or animal nervous system.
strengths: Can prevent the target from attacking.
May be able to cause paraylisis.
weaknesses: Contact-based Neuroburst requires contact with bare skin.

name: Nanotech Upgrade
description: The person with this power is able to upgrade vehicles or take over electrical objects by the use of an a nanotech arm. When in use to upgrade vehicles,a cable will come out from the arm; the more cables, the higher/faster the upgrade. The arm shoots a cylindrical bullet that releases nanites which override the electrical object programming. The arm is almost indestructable
summary: The ability to have a nanotech arm that can upgrade vehicles or take over other electrical objects
strengths: Good for upgrading your beat up car
Good for upgrading your car to catch fast villains
Can infiltrate and take down enemies that use a lot of tech as their arsenal
weaknesses: An EMP burst will short out the arm.
The arm can be destroyed or ripped apart from the user if a huge amount of strength is used

name: Power Reinvention
description: The user has to be near the person once to copy and reinvent their power. For example, if someone had the power to change the size of their hands, the user then copies the power then recreates it to becomes the user's unique version of that power. Now, the user can shoot a beam that makes anyone's hands big.
summary: The ability to absorb the essence of other superpowers and reinvent it to become a new power.
strengths: Gain many powers.
The powers you get are permanent.
weaknesses: The person's power that you absorbed is not taken away.
The power is not chosen by the user.

name: Radiation Energy Blast
description: The user is able to shoot radiation energy bolts and beams from his or her hands. The radiation will only effect the person it hits. The radiation will not affect, the user's allies as the user does not emanate radiation from his body unless he or she uses the power.
summary: The ability to shoot radiation energy
strengths: Very powerful power
weaknesses: Carbon will render this power useless
Unknown side effects to user in the long run

name: Shadow Kinetic Pulse
description: The user can steal the potiential energy then merge it into a grayish kinetic pulse. The objects and living things will be blown away especially those that can't move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to redirect it as a shockwave.
strengths: Powerful shockwave attacks
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: The Human Element
description: Allows you to draw energy from groups of people around you and you can use that energy to heal yourself or others,give yourself a boost eg. If your feeling tired it will wake you up.
summary: The ability to draw energy from people around you
strengths: Useful if you live in a big city.
People drinking coffee are almost unlimited power sources.
You can use it on your enemy to make them tired or have fatigue.
weaknesses: If there is not a crowd or group of people near you you can't use this power.
It's hard to control and you might use it on yourself by accident.
ONLY humans.

name: Momentum Charge
description: Charge any object or person with "momentum energy" then release it forcing them forward at massive speeds.
summary: The ability to charge objects with momentum
strengths: Works on any object you touch, including air.
Can charge yourself, increasing jump capacity
Turn objects or people into projectiles
weaknesses: Only works on objects you touch
Must release a certain amount of energy every 24 hours to prevent discomfort

name: Atomic Energy Manipulation
description: Atomic energy is what makes things what they are. Your control over this energy gives you great power. When you produce the energy it will appear as orange light and/or electicity. When you shoot it at something, your target's molecular structure will change in some way. For example, if you blast a chair, it might change into gold or some other material. Also it's atoms might rearrange themselves into something else, like a glass bowl. With practice, you might be able to control this change.
summary: The ability to manipulate atomic energy.
strengths: Manipulating Matter
Very powerful
You might be able to rearrange atoms
weaknesses: Very hard to control

name: Astro Spear
description: The Spear had many names (cosmic lance, galaxy pike, judas killer). It can give you the ability of flight & different variations have allowed different powers including; levitating objects, creating force fields for both offense and defense, manipulating energy, and creating simple energy constructs. The spear also will "attune itself" to the user allowing you to control the spear by thought. You can also use it to kill off dark magical demons & evil alien warlords.
summary: The ability to convert cosmic energy into powerful blasts & can destroy evil ailens and beings of dark magic.
strengths: Can convert any cosmic energy into powerful blast to aim it at your opponent.
It can only be used by the forces of light.
weaknesses: Nothing bad here.

name: Matter Motion Alteration
description: All matter is moving, even solid matter moving in a slow rate. With this ability, you can change the energy, that allows matter to move, at any speed you want. You can mostly use it on your body to make it as slow and solid as rock or as quick and unstable as liquid, gas, or plasma.
summary: The ability to increase or decrease the energy in atoms to alter any matter's structure and movement.
strengths: Can change the speed of energy in matter.
Can make things sturdy or unstable.
weaknesses: Can't think of one.

name: Life Energy Absorption Aura
description: Whenever someone dies within the radius of a kilometer of you (your aura), you feel their death and can choose to live x years longer, where x is the age of the person who died divided by ten. Every time you use this power, your aura decreases by 1 meter, so you can only use this 1000 times at max. This only expands your lifespan and does not prevent dying during your extended life.
summary: The ability to live longer when someone dies
strengths: Good for soldiers.
Can live longer.
Can choose whenever you want to use your power.
weaknesses: Does not prevent deaths.
Can only be used up to 1000 times.

name: Electro Magnetic Spectrum
description: You would be able to control the electromagnetic spectrum easily. Ranging from being able to pick up radio frequencies and manipulating them to attacking with high energy gamma waves. You dont even have to attack them because visible light is part of the spectrum so you could easily just blind them and leave.
summary: The ability to control the wavelength of all possible frequencies of radiation.
strengths: Amazing ranges of attacks
Offensive and defensive
weaknesses: Can be very deadly if you dont know what you are capable of

name: Kinetic Amplification
description: The kinetic force you exert when punching will be greatly amplified to a superhuman punch with lightning speed. So your strength & speed are charged with amped up kinetic energy & increased to greater power. Your jumps will be almost boundless. But if you pick up something heavy, you better throw it quick, because stopping/slowing down will decrease your kinetic energy down to normal. Plus you have to be careful what you through to, because that object will have the force of a speeding train.
summary: The ability to amplify your exerted kinetic force
strengths: Your exerted kinetic force will be amped
Increased strength & speed
weaknesses: Cannot really stop or slow down for the power energy will be less
Have to be careful when using your power, because you'll have wrecking ball force

name: Dna Modification
description: A person with this power has the ability to shoot a beam from their hands that changes other people by changing their DNA. At first the user can only change one variable such as height, strength, gender, hair color/length. However if used a lot the user can create variations in order to change someone to match someone else's appearance. When not used on an organic life form it takes the form of a stunning concussive blast. Once mastered this can be used to create or cure mutations to the DNA.
summary: The ability to fire a beam that causes anything in the receiving end to shapeshift
strengths: Turn people stronger/weaker or change appearance
No time limit
Can fire indefinitely like a laser
weaknesses: Has to learn how to control beams
Can't use on something without DNA or some sort of genetic code.
If you are firing a big beam you might hit some bacteria in the air

name: Void Control
description: This power is an ability that allows one to control the massive powers of the Void. This enables the person to disappear into Void regions,rendering him or her invisible to all, but the user can still see everything. This power also allows the use of making Void Skills such as: Shields, Barriers, Blasts, and other Void related power (This is usually placed in the Magic Category)
summary: The ability to enables one to control Void Power
strengths: This superpower enables one to escape from unwanted conflicts (Like your nagging siblings! )
Enables one to take out the opposition in a single shot
Can not be effected by any other superpowers, other than Power Canceling Abilities
weaknesses: Takes a huge amount of energy to use (Magic in place of energy if magic applies to the world... )
Takes a darn long time to activate

name: Power Accessing
description: You have the ability to get any power that has ever been created. This works by accessing some 'overpower' that unites all superhumans.
summary: The ability to able to access powers through a network of super-power energy
strengths: You get to have a few powers at the same time
It's quick and simple, just imagine the power, think about it, and you have it.
You can do it anywhere.
weaknesses: Only three powers at a time
There's a limit to how long you can "hold" onto the powers.
The more powers you gain, the less you'll be able to do with them

name: First Rule Of Business
description: The first rule of business is to turn all weaknesses into strengths. Give that a twist and you've got this. This will be better explained through an example. Let's say you have radiation poisoning. This power will allow you to focus that radiation into an energy blast or something. Any weakness you have will become a strength, making you very hard to hurt or beat.
summary: The ability to turn every weakness into a strength
strengths: No more weaknesses
A lot more strengths
Could gain great and vast powers
weaknesses: Makes you almost inhuman

name: Power Delegation
description: This ability is handy for those who have too much power. The user is able to give power or energy to parts of their body and give them special abilities. For example, giving your right hand the ability to shoot a small beam of light and giving your left hand the ability to release a small pulse. The main point is to help the user control their intense power by weakening it from the separation.
summary: The ability to assign power/energy to parts of one's body to give them abilities.
strengths: Create powers for each part of the body
Control one's intense power
weaknesses: The number of parts one can use at a time depends on how much power/energy they have.
Weak abilities

name: Click Boom
description:
When you click your fingers in a direction, a little arc of electricity shoots forth from your fingers and whatever it touches explodes! 
You could clap as well, or stamp your feet for bigger explosions.
summary: The ability to click your fingers and make stuff explode
strengths: It's easy to explode stuff
Some things explode in a fiery ball of, well, fire, while other stuff just shatters
It's cool!
weaknesses: Might not explode what you want (a little inaccurate)
If you're listening to an especially catchy song, you might kill yourself or those around you
You can't turn it off

name: Life Energy
description: With this power you can absorb life energy from any living thing by touch or from a distance. Once you have the energy you can use it to heal yourself and others and shoot energy blasts.
summary: The ability to absorb and use life energy.
strengths: You can heal yourself and others from dire injuries.
Weaken people by will.
Become more energized with the more energy you absorb.
weaknesses: Using to much of your own energy can cause you to fall weak.
Absorbing to much energy from a living thing can kill it.

name: Energy Absorption
description: This is the ability to extract the energy in matter and store it in your body, in a similar way to how burning a fuel extracts its energy as heat. Simply by touching an object, you can remove all of its energy. Energy you absorb can be used to power your body, removing your need for food, air or water and preventing aging. The energy you absorb can be expelled as any form of energy (radiation, electricity, heat, light, kinetic force etc.) and in any form (beams, blasts etc.)
summary: The ability to absorb and expel energy
strengths: Can absorb the energy from projectile attacks and enemy bodies
Can attack with any type of energy, making defense against you very tricky.
Can never starve if you can feed on the very air around you.
weaknesses: Extremely unreactive materials (e.g. gold) cannot be absorbed
If you expel all your energy, you will have no energy to start reactions and you will starve.

name: Aura Control
description: Every living thing has a aura which is a energy field surrounding it. Its similar to the glow around a neon sign. Someone with this power can focus it into energy constructs like objects,weapons,armor,or shapes. When your aura is activited(visible)a colored smoke will come off your skin. The smoke and your aura will be colored to your personality. All of your energy constructs will give off the smoke too. Also you can channel your aura into things to super charge them.
summary: The ability to focus your aura into shapes,or weapon.
strengths: You can have instant armor,weapons,and other stuff
You can channel your aura into stuff to super charge it
weaknesses: Over using your aura will cause you to combust
Can't control the color

name: Transfer Of Energy
description: Every action takes energy. Nothing can be done without it. With a little concentration, someone with this power can build up energy and direct it toward any action. They can spend energy all at once or over a period of time. However, Generators can't store this energy and save it or build up energy while using pre-generated energy. Like with most things, practice produces improvement. With more practice, users could generate more energy in sorter amount of time.
summary: The ability to build up and transfer energy into actions.
strengths: Any action can be done if you can build up enough energy.
With practice comes improvement
weaknesses: Not building up enough energy for something (when flying, levitating a car, being invisible, etc. )

name: Lightning Travel
description: You can travel at light speed through electronics and lightning. You can also enter games.
summary: The ability to travel through electronics or lightning.
strengths: If you have somewhere to be during a lightning storm, you're in luck.
Entering video games would be fun.
weaknesses: You may get shocked a little after using this power.

name: Object Duplication
description: As opposed to External Duplication, this power only allows you to create duplicates of objects you are currently touching. However, you can create as many copies as you want of any non-living object of any size. The duplicates can appear anywhere in your vicinity or anywhere in your visual field. The bigger the object, the more energy you'll need to create even one copy of it. Also, they will only remain as long as you keep touching the original object.
summary: The ability to create copies of any object you are touching.
strengths: Create as many duplicates as you want of any object.
You can make the copies appear wherever you want in your vicinity, not just in your hand.
You can even duplicate just the parts of the object you want.
weaknesses: You need to touch the object to duplicate it. If you stop touching, the copies will disappear.
You need a lot of energy to create a copy of a big object.
Doesn't work on living objects.

name: Chaotic Clap
description: You can gather massive amounts of energy in your palms and release a concussive blast by clapping. This power completely envelopes you in a force field to deflect projectiles, but could also knock your opponents off their feet if they were too close.
summary: The ability to gather an amount of powerful energy in your hands, and fire it at your foe in a force field clap.
strengths: Could also create some explosions by clapping.
weaknesses: Might not work on gigantic adversaries.

name: Equilibrium   Absorb And Repel
description: Equilibrium allows the user to restore and maintain balance in any given situation. This ability is dynamic, altering depending upon the current requirements to maintain balance. In the case of attacks, it can be used to form barriers that absorb attacks (thus preventing alterations in balance) as well as releasing that force as a powerful concussive blast, similar to a controlled shock wave. Can be used as a personal shield or extended to other people or objects.
summary: The ability to generate a barrier that absorbs and repels attacks.
strengths: Personal Immunity to attacks
Able to sheild others from attacks
Manifests on its own
weaknesses: Can absorb only a set amount of damage
Useless against mental attacks
Absorbed energy must be released to continue defence

name: Energy Blade Hands
description: You can turn your hand into a large energy sword. Stab, slice, and cut up your enemies. These blades can cut through anything.
summary: The ability to turn your hands into blades of energy
strengths: Can cut through anything
Kill enemies with one slice
weaknesses: Takes a lot of power to use

name: Age Shifting
description: This ability allows the user to shift from his current age to any age he desires at will. You could age (which is called Maturation if you can ONLY do this) or de-age (called Infantilization if you can ONLY do this) as much as you want. While age-shifted, you take on the characteristics of your assumed age group (energy of a kid, wisdom and patience of old age).
summary: The ability to alter one's age at will
strengths: Chuck E. Cheese ball pit in the afternoon, hit the club for vodka by 11pm
Nobody knows your true age (change it at will, live for a LONG time, maybe forever if not killed)
Get a woman pregnant, become an old guy/kid as a disguise
weaknesses: Some people will hit you no matter what age you are
Chronokinetics/Age-Manipulators can trap you at a certain age
True Sight sees your true age and Reality Anchoring prevents you from Age Shifting

name: Ability Cloaking
description: With this power you can make your powers completely undetectable. You can also make your powers invisible. For example if you have laser vision the lasers are invisible. Or if you summon something the thing you summon is invisible and so on and so forth. You can turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to cause your abilities to be undetectable and invisible
strengths: You can make your powers undetectable
You can make your powers invisible
weaknesses: If this is your only power this does absolutely nothing

name: Ultimatum Immunity
description: This ability allows one to not be affected by ultimatums; he doesn't have to suffer the consequence of any difficult decision. This means that the user's luck increases so that he can survive the effects, but only temporary. The user is even immune to events that, in root, were caused by an ultimatum, even a nuclear blast.
summary: The ability to unaffected by ultimatums, supernatural or otherwise.
strengths: Never make any difficult choices again.
Protection against event and things caused by ultimatums.
Temporary luck boost until the negative events caused by a ultimatum has passed.
weaknesses: Only works for ultimatums

name: Kinetic Dampener
description: The person with this power forms a small field around his or her body that will dampen kinetic energy. This is different from invulnerability because, with this power you are immune to bullets or punches by not concussive beams or radiation blast.
summary: The ability to dampen kinetic force making you take no damage if a kinetic based attack is launched at you
strengths: Can stop bullets in its track
Good for fighting crimes
weaknesses: Your powers does not work if confronted by someone using magic
Only can stop kinetic force

name: Electromagnetic Absorption
description: Photosynthesis works on a very limited range of frequencies (and not the one for green light, hence the colour of plants). However, imagine if you could absorb *any* frequency of light, be it Radio waves, Microwaves, or even Gamma rays. A person with this ability would be living in the perfect era, as electromagnetic radiation is all around us, what with cellular and Wifi networks etc. This power can be activated at will, but if it is used for too long it could have disastrous consequences.
summary: The ability to absorb any frequency of light and convert it to energy.
strengths: Limitless source of energy that is abundant in today's society.
Can be drawn on as a source of energy for more tiring powers.
weaknesses: If it is activate for too long you'll at best become really fat, or at worst die from the overload.
You would completely disrupt signal anywhere you were using it.
Doesn't protect you from the damaging consequences of high frequency radiation (Gamma rays).

name: Photokinesis
description: With Photokinesis you can produce light at any time from your own body. With this light, you can shoot energy beams from any part of your body, but unless you were EXTREMELY adept you would not be able to produce the intensity to make harmful beams come from your whole body at once. Preferred method is to use your hands. You can also create illusions, or blind your enemies.
summary: The ability to produce and control light.
strengths: You can see anywhere.
You don't need artificial weaponry.
You can make people believe almost anything through the use of illusions.
weaknesses: It's difficult to control.
It can be hard to hide.
It's not too remarkable in the light.

name: Free Space Manipulation
description: Free space is an abstraction from nature, a baseline or reference state, that is unattainable in practice, like the absolute zero of temperature. It is characterized by the parameter known as the permeability of free space or the magnetic constant, by the parameter, called the permittivity of free space or electric constant, and by the speed of light. With this one can manipulate electromagnetism and "Vacuum" or namely non-zero pressure.
summary: The ability to manipulate Free Space
strengths: Manipulate free space
weaknesses: Turns things into free space atomizes them, changing them into free floating particles, Empty space.

name: Electronegative Pulse
description: Your able to take all your anger, aggression, rage, and hatred and transform it into an energy source of electrical and negative energy. This ability also increases your physical attributes to supernatural levels.
summary: The ability to convert your own intense emotions into electronegative energy
strengths: You can summon this energy anytime you want to
It has a special healing quality
It's only given to individuals that have a pure heart and honest mind
weaknesses: It's fueled by bad memories, anger, rage, hate, fustration, or depression
This power is a rare and unstable form of energy that has to be learned to be controlled
It's a very dangerous power source if in the wrong hands

name: Trailshocker
description: You can turn yourself into a thunderbolt in the air, dashing through the sky at a very fast speed leaving behind a stream of electricity.
summary: The ability to fly leaving a trail of a lightning bolt behind you.
strengths: You can fly while being a thunderbolt.
You can even shock and tackle your foe.
weaknesses: Can't use it underwater.
You can't go through control electricity
You can't go through power lines

name: Inator Creator
description: All you would have to do would be say "(the thing you want to do)inator!", aim your hands at your target, and enjoy. For example, you could say "destructinator!", aim your hands at a bag of garbage, and *poof*, no more garbage! This ability can be used with all sorts of inators. Ones such as the shrinkinator, begoneinator, freezeinator, badbreathinator, and everyone's favorite, the chucknorriscomesandbeatsyoureneimiesheadsininator.
summary: The ability to create any manner of beams, rays, waves, or blasts of energy.
strengths: You can make inator beams, rays, waves, or blasts
You can make different types of inators.
You don't have to say the name, just think it (but saying it looks a lot cooler)
weaknesses: It can be hard to think of a name for your inators
Umm that's it, adios

name: Invisibility Projection
description: You can project an aura at will that bends light around objects, making them completely invisible. However, you cannot create this aura around yourself.
summary: The ability to make objects you touch invisible
strengths: Can hide objects you're holding
Would be great for magic tricks
Safes and walls can hide nothing from you
weaknesses: Cannot hide yourself
Have to learn how to open safes if you want to open them using this power
If you lose contact with the object, it quickly fades into view

name: Gift: Lightning
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling lightning and electricity than other beings. Thus their electrical and lightning-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of electricity and lightning from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve electrical powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of electricity
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over lightning as someone with this power.
Lightning-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only lightning-based powers now.

name: Momentum Alteration
description: Discover that you can bend the laws of nature in a spectacular way; take for instance the ability to redefine the details of conservation of angular momentum. Magnifying the spin applied by any amount of force to make objects turn with incredible speed, then add to that by translating the angular momentum into energy of a more useful kind, transforming it into an effective weapon.
summary: The ability to charge the angular momentum of objects!
strengths: Spinning a coin can blow up a room.
The game of Frisbee takes on a whole new level of pain.
The slightest modification to a car's wheel can result in devastation of whole city blocks.
weaknesses: Could result in user's own demise.
Could destroy more than anticipated.
Can't affect organic materials, such as humans, animals or trees.

name: Elemental Genetics Swap
description: The user has the ability to switch any of their abilities that they are naturally capable of with any element to gain an elemental ability similar to it. Example: the user swap his natural ability of turning food into energy, then swap that with gold, and now all the food turns into gold. This ability also works genetic disabilities. You could make them better. The effects are not permanent.
summary: The ability to exchange one's own genetic/ natural ability/ functions for an elemental equivalent.
strengths: Gain new and unique abilities
Make disorders or other bad genetic traits into elemental abilities.
Also works on brain functions
weaknesses: Effects are not permanent
Might be horrible side effects of changing genes.

name: The Aura Of Dracula.
description: This power is the ability to hypnotize anyone with your aura and drain them of their energy, will-power and powers like how a vampire drinks blood. This enables the user to control their subjects and corrupt them, making them their minions.   The subject must be a human or superhuman being in order for this to work and they must be easy to manipulate, it does not work on demons, timelords, demigods or robots but works fine with superhero/superheroine types.
summary: The ability to hypnotize Anyone and Make Them Your Minions
strengths: Can be used on superheroes or superheroines.
You can drain them of their powers.
You can corrupt them and make them your minions.
weaknesses: Doesn't work on demons or robots.
Characters with higher resistance levels are more difficult to hypnotize.
Doesn't work on timelords or demi-gods.

name: Firestorm Matrix
description: The firestorm matrix enables whoever has it to transform into Firestorm, a person who is both man and nuclear energy. When the user is in Firestorm form they can shoot nuclear energy blast, transmute objects, loosen up molecules that are binding a object together and fly.
summary: The ability to have an access to the Firestorm Matrix, transforming him or her into Firestorm
strengths: Can combat crime ranging from small to large crimes.
Can fly around.
Can go head to head with certain powerhouses.
weaknesses: Lead might hinder your powers.
Certain powerhouses might be too strong for you.
Hard to master powers, especially transmutation.

name: Psionic Spheres
description: These spheres can be thrown like projectiles; sometimes these sphere detonate like time bombs, hid underneath the surface of the ground like mines, can be rolled like balls and then explode and many other uses. One with this ability is immune to the psionic energy.
summary: The ability to generate spheres of intense psionic energy.
strengths: One can detonate these spheres at any time.
Your foes wont suspect the "mines".
With time one can change the size of the spheres, adding more psionic energy to them.
weaknesses: Another person that has an ability such as, Energy Absorption, is immune to the psionic as well.
Can take time to learn how to make them explode at will.
When this ability is undeveloped, the users sphere will explode on contact and will send one flying.

name: Electrical Discharge
description: With this ability, you can issue forth arcs of electricity from the body. This ability does not allow the user to manipulate electricity (disrupt it, redirect it, deflect it, etc.), just produce it. The amount, manifestation (bolt, arc, spark, flash, etc.) and other properties of the lightning is not up to the user.
summary: The ability to fire arcs of electricity from the body
strengths: Produce electrical power as a source of energy or attack
Usually, it's pretty powerful electricity
Electricity enhances strikes (punches and kicks)
weaknesses: If your power goes off in water, it shocks YOU
People who can manipulate absorb and conduct electricity
Doesn't render you immune to electricity

name: Potential Kinesis
description: Through direct touch this power can charge objects with potential energy which will convert into the type of energy (energies) that object emits. for example, charging a torch will emit heat and light energy. Objects that don't convert energy will kinetically move. Potential-kinesis allows conversions into the following energy: Kinetic (Movement) Heat (Thermal) Electrical Light (Radiant) Nuclear Chemical Sound Cosmic Magnetic Elastic and gravitational potential energy.
summary: The ability to charge objects with potential energy.
strengths: Unlimited power supply.
Multiple domestic, Entreprenurial and combat uses.
Like many powers in one
weaknesses: Cannot manipulate the forms of energy emitted
Cannot control variations (Speed, direction, temperature, etc)

name: Ability Imbuing
description: An Ability Imbuer has a unique power. They can make normal objects superpowered objects with concentration. This takes time--75 minutes or so--but the results are spectacular. Electric swords, an indestructible jacket, a gun that can never miss, etc. This is more effective the closer a connection you have with the object--objects you made yourself will keep their powers for centuries. Other objects may lose their abilities in a year or so. This does not work on people.
summary: The ability to imbue objects with superpowered attributes
strengths: Electricity-generating swords, indestructible jacket, etc.
More effective the closer the connection you have it with it
Self-made objects keep their abilities for centuries
weaknesses: Takes somewhere around 75 minutes
Less important objects lose their abilities in a year
Does not work on people

name: Energy Booster
description: With this power you can boost the energy output in every energy source. You get the power from the sun. You can only use this power in direct sunlight or else it will use your own life force.
summary: The ability to boost any energy source.
strengths: You can make you or anyone else immortal by boosting their life force.
Can shatter light bulbs.
Will never have to pay for new batteries again.
weaknesses: The sun charges your power so you can't use it at night or in a windowless room.
You will get a horribly painful shock if you try to use your power on wet ground.
If you get very angry you can blow yourself up with as much energy as an atom bomb.

name: Sunlight Manipulation
description: With this, you can make weapons from mere sunlight. You can create shields of sunlight and you can make energy constructs, etc. You're always powerful under the sun. A high level user can learn to produce sunlight as well.
summary: The ability to control and produce sunlight
strengths: You're powerful all day long
Best against vampires
Never use a night light again
weaknesses: Must be very experienced to produce sunlight
Might accidentally blind someone

name: Ability Skill:Material Revival
description: This ability revives those who have the ability to produce any kind of material, matter or energy. If they are killed, they can scatter/disperse like the material energy/they produce or mimic. They can then reform the material/energy into their original form and revert back to normal. Good examples are Majin Buu and the T-1000.
summary: The ability to revive oneself by being the matter/energy they produce if they have an ability to create it.
strengths: When you die, you can reform/revive
Regain your original form.
Also works if you can mimic an material/energy
weaknesses: Only works when you're killed.

name: Redirect Ambient Energy
description: There is energy locked in objects all around us. Your average cup of coffee has 303 degrees Kelvin thermal energy; your average uranium atom can devastate a city. A person who can Redirect Ambient Energy can take energy from an object via their hand and send it through their other hand as thermal blasts.
summary: The ability to draw up energy and immediately project it
strengths: Massive power everywhere
Takes little effort to use
Very deterrent
weaknesses: Must maintain physical contact with object
Must not lose control, or risk atomic explosion
Limited to amount of energy in object

name: Living  Lightning
description: Using this power, the user can create constructs made from living lightning. These constructs take the form of animals and are just as powerful and fast as the animals they take the forms of. When they make contact with something the user can have them shock the target.
summary: The ability to create living lightning
strengths: Can shock your enemies with a giant gorilla
Don't need to touch foes to use powers
Don't need to direct your lightning
weaknesses: Not as fast or powerful as actual lightning
Can't generate fake animals
Can only make 3 constructs at a time

name: Plasma Whips
description: With this power you can summon and control two whips of pure energy. The whips originate in your palm and can extend up to 50 yards. The whips give off intense heat and cause great damage, but if you don't want to cause damage you can cause the whips to only give off mild heat. You can use the whips to slice, burn, and/or grab objects or people. You can use them to grab a building to stop a fall or twirl one in a circle to act as a shield.
summary: The ability to wield two whips of energy
strengths: Whips are deadly, versatile, nearly unbreakable weapons
Can control amount of heat whips give off to cause more or less damage
Can mentally cause whips to expand or grab something
weaknesses: Whips can only extend 50 yards

name: Precognitive Blast
description: Precognitive Blast is the ability to generate a blast out of energy from the future and fire it at foes; or it may fire at the subject before they know that danger is near; or it may channel the precognitive power (normally used to find future information) into a blast which may induce visions of the future.
summary: The ability to fire a blast of precognitive energy as an offensive attack
strengths: Finally, an offensive use for precognition
It's actually a concussive attack
May induce visions of the future
weaknesses: It only works on people
People might not take you seriously ("Precognitive blast? ")
If your power goes off before you realize danger is present, you can't consciously stop it

name: Biomantium
description: With this power, your tissue becomes adamantium. Since it is your tissue, you can move as normal. This power can be turned on and off but upon turning it off you need to re-charge for a short time before re-activation. Adept users can shorten the time it takes re-charge. This power is low impact when it is on. Since it is passive, the user doesn't need to expend any energy to keep it going.
summary: The ability to change you skin in to adamantium, an indestructible metal
strengths: You're covered in adamantium
Almost nothing can hurt you
weaknesses: When it's on, you're magnetic
Mental attacks work the same

name: Laser Emission
description: Laser is an acronym for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation. It's really an extremely powerful ray of light. A Laser Emitter can produce a laser from their fingertip that can pierce a 2 foot block of steel--or generally anything else.
summary: The ability to generate powerful lasers from your fingers.
strengths: Can pierce most anything
Looks very cool
Powerful offensive skill
weaknesses: Almost no worth as a defense
Takes concentration
Maximum range 70 yards

name: Music Manipulation
description: You can control & manipulate music with this power. Change the volume of the music. Change the way it sounds. You can make a guitar sound like a trumpet, for a limited time. Change the pitch of voices; a soprano can be deepened to a mezzo-soprano! A bass can be raised to a tenor! You can even create synth sounds! Ever heard of Sound Forge?
summary: The ability to manipulate music
strengths: Control the volume of music, make it quiet so you don't disturb pesky music-haters!
Change the way musical instruments sound, like a synthesizer!
Make it louder & easier to hear.
weaknesses: You can't manipulate music that is too far away, such as a distance of 3 miles.
Don't make the music too loud or you could go deaf!
Not everyone loves music.

name: Kinetic Charging
description: Kinetic energy: the energy of motion. A Kinetic Charger can increase an object's kinetic energy by touch. The next time the object touches another, it will explode. This makes everything and anything a dangerous weapon. You must touch the object to make it charged.
summary: The ability to charge matter with explosive kinetic energy
strengths: Totally voluntary
Next time charged object touches another, it will explode
Everything is a weapon
weaknesses: Must touch to charge
Takes more energy to charge larger objects
Cannot uncharge objects

name: Electrical Absorption
description: The most electricity a human can take is 400,000 Watts. A person with Electrical Absorption can store up to ten times that without harm. In addition, they can later release that energy at will.
summary: The ability to absorb electrical energy harmlessly
strengths: Become the best electrician ever
Give Taser freaks a taste of their own medicine
Can store huge voltage indefinitely
weaknesses: Can run out of juice without much warning
Is possible to absorb too much power and hurt yourself
Emotional outbursts may activate a discharge

name: Bio  Em Field
description: The person with this power is able to generate a bio EM field. With this bio-EM field, he or she is able to wreck havoc on EM powered equipment, generate bio electric energy, and track people using by their bioelectrical pulse
summary: The ability to generate a bio-EM field to wreck havoc with EM powered equipment
strengths: Can screw up with enemies' electrical equipment
Can enter enemies' hideout undetected
weaknesses: Does not destroy the equipment, simply screws it up

name: Shadow Kinetic Basic
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them in order to turn it into give them extra energy to keep them going through their activities. Other than that, it just immobolizes opponents or objects before they move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to give the user extra energy.
strengths: Extra energy
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Power Safety
description: When you get this power, all your powers including this one become immune to negation, draining, mimicking, stealing, trapping you if you have them, inhibitation, sealing, being taken away or destroyed, being targeted by harming effects specific to your powers, being eaten, deactivated, made useless and many other protections. Your aura cannot be stolen or destroyed or sealed away.
summary: The ability to have your powers immune to harming effects.
strengths: Do not fear myth eater or killer.
Virtually invincible with strong abilities.
weaknesses: None, unless you don't want powers.

name: Internal Solar Fusion
description: Your body houses an ultra-bright star, and can utilize the fusion taking place to draw on limitless energy reserves. You are also able to project various solar energies, such as magnetic bursts, heat waves or streams of supercharged ions. This is an incredibly destructive power. The user can also utilize all of that moments solar potential to create a devastating supernova pulse. The solar energy can be utilized to make light, heat, to heal the user, or even to fly.
summary: The ability to manipulate solar fusion and its effects.
strengths: Limitless energy means that you never need to sleep.
A most destructive superpower. It can quite possibly destroy planets.
weaknesses: This power makes the user physically and mentally unstable.
The user can "Overheat". This causes them to disintegrate to dust after going nuclear.

name: Mirror Image
description: You can leave a mirror image of yourself at your current location that will perform only the last action that you were doing. The mirror image will look exactly like you, including having a copy of any item you had, and will be near impossible to tell apart from you. You can have as many mirror images as you have energy for and can dismiss the mirror images at any time. If you are doing a chore the mirror image will continue until it is done, or if using a weapon it will continue to do the same.
summary: The ability to leave a mirror image of yourself at your location.
strengths: Leave a mirror image to continue doing an action for you.
Can have several mirror images all copying you using your powers at a foe.
Can leave a mirror image as a decoy.
weaknesses: The mirror images can only do one action or command.
Have to be at the location that you want to leave your mirror image.
The mirror images can be destroyed easily.

name: Olive Green Power Ring
description: The user is able to form constructs, force fields, shoot beams or bolts of energy that comes from the mysterious energy of peace. The ring only chooses people who are peaceful in nature or strive for peace and at the same time having a distaste for war or any senseless violence. The only weakness of the ring comes from the energy of senseless violence. The ring's symbol is an olive branch. The Olive Green Peace corps sign central battery is located on peaceful planet where nature is abundant.
summary: The ability to use the mysterious olive green energy of peace
strengths: Can make construct out of pure energy of peace
Can make other be calmer in situations, making them more peaceful in nature
weaknesses: Must recharge the ring
Weak against the power of senseless violence ( the color blood red )

name: Property Imbuing
description: With this power, you can "program" an element with a particular property, within limits. There are restrictions on properties, but you still have a lot of freedom. You could make an element turn movement into electricity, a lightweight but superdense material or a material which could withstand the temperatures and pressures of the inside of the sun. You can also change one element into another. The time it takes depends on what you are converting. It takes a lot of concentration to perform.
summary: The ability to design chemical elements with desired properties.
strengths: Make armor nearly indestructible.
Turn trash into gold.
Have lots of freedom.
weaknesses: Requires a lot of concentration.
It isn't ability imbuing -you are giving objects properties, not powers.
Some properties cannot coexist -its best to just give each object one property.

name: Uncontrollable Energy
description: Harness anger, hope or even determination into energy. This energy can sometimes be uncontrollable.
summary: The ability to harness anger, hope or determination into energy
strengths: You can have lots of power
Enables you to do more inhuman things
weaknesses: Sometimes uncontrollable

name: Endless Blood
description: With this power the user will never run out of blood within his bodily system. Any lost blood is immediately replaced without needing any energy from the user. The blood will be the same blood type as the persons normal blood. Open wounds will continually bleed until the wound is closed. This power is normally always on, so the supply of blood can not be turned off. The blood can be used to fuel other blood related powers.
summary: The ability to have a endless supply of blood.
strengths: Never fear blood loss.
Can donate an infinite supply of blood.
Always have a supply of blood for other blood related powers.
weaknesses: Can not be directly controlled by the user through this power.
If wounds do not close the bleeding would never stop.
The blood will be the same as your normal blood.

name: Power Crystals
description: Power crystals are crystals of great power. They can be (if done properly) used as energy sources, but can also give great powers to humans. With simple exposure, you could gain any sort of power. But depending on how someone is exposed to them, they can have different effects. You can also manipulate them, so you could use them as weapons or structures. You can even control when they are activated (glowing), meaning when they can grant abilities.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate power crystals.
strengths: You can control and shape power-granting crystals
Studying different kinds of exposure could allow you to control what they do to people
weaknesses: Sometimes the crystals can have bad effects

name: Unstoppability
description: With this power you can charge through anything, be it a dense wall, or a living foe. A person with this has inertia to keep going for however long the user likes (although they can get tired and stop of the their own will, and can sometimes be moved by outside forces), and though any obstacle, to reach any target, or just to tackle a foe with phenomenal force.
summary: The ability to charge straight through any subject
strengths: Can go through anything.
Can stop whenever one chooses too.
When charging through living foes, their bodies and left in shreds, bits, pieces, etc.
weaknesses: Can still tire.
Can still be stopped my outside forces ( psychics, a person with persuasion, etc)
The damage of Unstoppability

name: Aura Communication
description: You can send messages to and recieve messages from anyone who is either at least one centimetre in your aura or has you at least one centimetre in their aura. Noone can stop the messages from being sent or recieved.
summary: The ability to communicate with others by way of contact with auras
strengths: Instant uninterceptible communication during combat!
weaknesses: Messages will go in a straight line and will be recieved by anyone who is in between you (to con 2)
(from con 1) and the intended reciever as long as they are also within your aura.

name: Rod Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. It is more effective at very low light intensity. With it, you have an enhanced night vision, but you can't see if there's no light at all. It also allows you to convert darkness into electricity. The darker it is, the more voltage you produce. Alternatively, you can convert darkness into special signals. By sending them to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you'll make them see what you see. This power can be disrupted by flashes of light.
summary: The ability to see better in the dark, convert darkness into electricity and allow people to see what you see.
strengths: You can see in the dark better than a normal human being, provided there's enough light.
You can electrocute someone if it's dark enough.
By touching the back of the head of a human person, you can show them what you see.
weaknesses: It can work at high light intensity, but there'll be a cooldown period before it works in the dark.
Because of con 1, this power can be disrupted by flashes of light.
In bright light, you can only create very low-voltage electrical impulses.

name: Soundwave Skin
description: You create the soundwaves by screaming which will cover and protect you. The soundwaves will cause anything that touches them except for you to be blasted backwards by a shockwave from the sound. While the sound is protecting you, you are immune to any loud noises that would hurt your ears to the point of nearly deafening you.
summary: The ability to protect oneself with soundwaves that are right on top of one's skin
strengths: Sound-damage immunity combined with a barrier.
weaknesses: Powers that annihilate other powers. Ex: Power Burning or Negation.
Your throat will hurt while using this power.

name: Plasma Knives
description: The Plasma Knives are similar to butterfly and automatic knives, but you can shock your opponetns with them. You coluld also charge them up and fire plasma-bolts with them.
summary: The ability to use them to stab and shock your enemies.
strengths: Can use them like a combination of taser and knives.
weaknesses: Not a good thing against water-type foes.

name: Electron Kinesis
description: A person with this power has the ability to control electrons. They can utilize electrons from any element. However, it is more difficult to remove electrons from noble gasses. They cannot control elements themselves, only electrons. However, even with that limitation, they can still do many things. They can create static electricity by transferring electric charges. They can also induce chemical reactions. Also, they can bend electrons to create an electron cannon.
summary: The ability to control electrons for various effects
strengths: Can make static electricity by transferring charges between atoms
Cause reactions to occur
Can bend electrons to create an electron cannon
weaknesses: Not immune to own shocks
Cannot control electric charge, only direct it
Needs a calm mind to control electrons correctly

name: Missiles
description: With this power you can cause missiles of any size or power to hit anything or anyone you want. You are immune to the effects of the missiles you create; this includes the explosion and, if there is any, nuclear radiation.
summary: The ability to cause missiles of any size to hit wherever you want
strengths: You can make missiles of any size or power level to hit whatever you want
You are immune to the effects of your missiles
weaknesses: You can still be hurt by other missiles
You might accidentally hurt innocent people with your missiles

name: Negative Energy Absorption
description: This ability allows one to absorb negative energy and redirect it if chosen.
summary: The ability to absorb and/or generate negative energy.
strengths: You can absorb other's negative emotions
You can purge others from negative energy and thoughts
You can redirect the absorbed energy as an energy blast
weaknesses: If used too much, one can become overhelmed by negative energy and become evil

name: Aura Wolves
description: The wolves look as though they are not fully solid, but they are fully capable of ripping an enemy apart tooth and nail. Their coloring differs dependent on what one's aura is like and they have their own personalities. Also the wolves cannot go outside the radius of where one's aura can be felt.
summary: The ability to create wolves from one's own aura
strengths: A giant aura radius.
The wolves can be great allies and companions.
weaknesses: Having the power No Aura.

name: Amalgamative Touch
description: Whenever you touch something, be it a person or an object that entity will pulse with a green surge of electricity every few seconds until you come into contact with another entity. An ominous green light will fade in and out from the two points of contact until you bring your hands together, at which point the two chosen objects will float towards each other and either fuse completely making something new or fuse partially so both functions may still be used.
summary: The ability to combine many different entities or objects into one.
strengths: Make new animals or objects from already existing stuff.
No need for glue.
Make everything better and more efficient.
weaknesses: When you disassemble or destroy something you have fused, you experience some backlash.
Puts some strain on your mind.
Other people can use the things you fuse.

name: Singularity Beam
description: The beam will destroy anything made of normal matter or energy. It won't affect anything that is immune to changes in the laws of physics or things that defy the laws of physics. Hence, immutability and physics rejector will protect the user from this beam. Invulnerability would also stop this power. Someone who is intangible in some way would also be unaffected. The beam will destroy a foe made of air or energy and keep going until it hits something solid or liquid which will stop the beam.
summary: The ability to generate a beam from your hand that duplicates the effects of a black hole core.
strengths: Destroy anything made of normal matter or energy.
The beam only stops when it hits something solid or liquid.
