weaknesses: Someone with immutability, quantum intangibility, space-time indemnity, physics rejector,
Invulnerability or any powers that are similar to these powers.
Any foe who isn't made of normal matter or energy.

name: Raikatana
description: The Raikatana is a legendary move that is very strong. The user's inner energy is transformed into lightning that is condensed and transformed into a glowing yellow blade that sprouts from the user's hand. Anything that gets hit by the blade is electrified. This technique is strong enough to slice metal. The Raikatana makes a very distinct noise of chirping electricity and roaring thunder whilst attacking.
summary: The ability to create a sword made entirely out of lightning.
strengths: It is strong enough to slice through metal.
Good for close range combat.
If you cut your opponent, even slightly, they will be electrified and probably unable to move.
weaknesses: This power fails against earth based techniques, being lightning.
The faster you move the louder the sword gets.
You can not use other techniques while you have the sword activated.

name: On The Bright Side
description: You can control the energy of light. Turn it into balls of energy and toss it at people, or just use it as your own personal flashlight!
summary: The ability to control light
strengths: Light is usually around most of the time
When it's bright, it's powerful!
weaknesses: Whenever you take the light from somewhere, it doesn't come back for awhile after use
The weaker the light, the weaker your powers.
It drains your energy when there is no light around.

name: Bioelectricity Absorption
description: This ability allows you to absorb others' bioelectricity, making the brain unable to send charges to your limbs and organs so they can do what you want and what they're suppose to. For example, when you want your arm to move or when your heart beats. You can also absorb others' bioelectricity to make your limbs and organs move and work faster.
summary: The ability to absorb others' bioelectricity
strengths: You can cause an enemy to be immobilized
You and your body can work faster
weaknesses: If no one's around you, you are powerless (unless you have other abilities)

name: Yin And Yang Manipulation
description: Yin, the passive, healing element. Yang, the aggressive, harming element. With this ability, you have a mastery of both. This means that you can impart yin energy into subjects to heal them, to heighten their defenses against illness and harm, or even deflect yang attacks. With yang, you can do just the opposite. Hurt foes with a blast or beam, weaken foes physically and deflect the effects of yin. The two naturally cancel one another out, and thus are useless being used against each other.
summary: The ability to alter the elements of yin and yang
strengths: Yin energy can be used to heal (yourself and others), raise defenses and deflect yang
Yang energy can be used to harm (blasts, beams, enhanced strikes), lower defenses and deflect yin
Yin energy can induce good bahvior, Yang energy can induce bad behavior
weaknesses: Yin is harmless, so it can't be used to harm AT ALL (in case you're more skilled at Yin)
Yang is harmful, so it can't be used to heal AT ALL (in case you're more skilled at Yang)
Yin and Yang used together is a null attack (no harm is taken, no damage is healed)

name: Wish Magnetism
description: The user will be able to attract the benefits of any one who made a wish that's coming true, or a reality warper who is warping reality. This ability has a near universal range. Any wish can become the user's and he can take all the benefits leaving the wisher or reality warper with the consequences. The user can redirect the wish if he doesn't want it. The effects of warped reality and certain wishes will were off.
summary: The ability to attract or redirect the benefits of any person's wish or desire.
strengths: Take a person's wish or desired reality.
Redirect wish
weaknesses: The effects of warped reality and certain wishes will were off.

name: Mark Of Shock
description: The user plants a mark in the target that allows him to electrify him from any distance. They can control the intensity of the shock and as an added bonus, the target attracts other electric-based attacks.
summary: The ability to electrocute people from distance
strengths: Good to inmobilize
Easy kill
weaknesses: Needs physical contact to place the mark
The mark can be removed
Emotions might affect the discharge

name: Atomic Bond Manipulation
description: With this ability one could do pretty much anything one chooses. Want to use it for good? Make weapons cease to be... then turn them into bonds for the bad guys. Evil's your style? Rip people apart just by looking at them, or torture them one atom at a time.
summary: The ability to manipulate molecules and atoms at will
strengths: Manipulate matter
Free Energy!!!
Weapons are worthless
weaknesses: Can't create things, atoms and molecule have to be formed already

name: Super Athlete
description: With this power you can be unbeatable at any sport; from baseball to race car driving to laser tag.
summary: The ability to be unbeatable at any sport
strengths: You can't be beaten in any sport
weaknesses: You can't use your sports skills in battle, such as paintball sharpshooting with a real gun

name: Vicarious Impulse
description: Impulses: bio-electric energy produced by the brain as to allow movement and thought. The user is able to speed up, slow down, completely stop, and even steal impulses from others in order to cause the target's brain and body functions to cease just by thinking so. Seizing impulses, the user can store knowledge of the target alongside their own, be it special abilities or memories.
summary: The ability to manipulate thought processing
strengths: Sever a target's motor functions
Send a target into a vegetative state
User learns by taking skills
weaknesses: User might be the victim of their own attack against a target who has reversal talents

name: Enhanced Effect
description: The user of this power is capable of achieving more effect from any action than the effort they put into it. In addition any effect achieved through the users actions may apply to realms beyond those it characteristically impacts. Touch, language, and action may bypass the material realm, affecting beings on other planes or merely being increased to heightened levels(e.g. whispering could become as loud as shouting, tapping to striking, etc). The influence of this power is determined by intent.
summary: The ability to increase and apply the affect of all your actions to matter or energy.
strengths: Tactile Manipulation of matter and energy( Tearing through steel can be as easy as tearing paper).
At higher levels influence the astral, and divine realms as easily as you could the physical.
Extends to communication, allowing the user to converse with anything that communicates.
weaknesses: Applies only to touch until higher levels. NCN
Despite the power to communicate with almost anything it does not give omnilinguism. NCN
Some effort IS required to actually trigger the effects of the power.

name: Solar Electricty Ball
description: By absorbing an unlimited amount of sunlight one can produce immense amounts of electrical power. One can also fuse the energies of solar and electricity to increase the power, but this takes time and practice. The power has less limited energy during the day when the sun is out but the energy is more limited at night.
summary: The ability to generate a ball of intense electrical and solar energy by absorbing sunlight
strengths: Immense electrical reserves
Super powerful technique
Can fuse energies of solar and electricty
weaknesses: Ball is unstable and could explode before use
Radiation exposure
Uncontrolable electrical discharge

name: Arceusforce: Judgment
description: The user holds a mighty force with this power. Their hair becomes white, skin becomes golden and eyes become green with burning red pupils. They have all of the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Normal-type. They gain supernatural condition as well as the ability to generate raw energy for attacks such as Hyper Beam and Giga Impact. With intense training, the user can transform into other elemental types and summon Arceus' almighty Judgment, a powerful light shower of the elements.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus, creator of the Pokemon universe.
strengths: The user is immune to spectral attacks in default form.
Generation of raw energy for various attacks.
BOW TO THE SHEER FORCE OF JUDGMENT!!!!
weaknesses: The user is weak to supernatural physical combat in default form.
This power may be too powerful for the user. (Especially Judgment)
Intense training is required to access the other elemental forms of Arceus as well as Judgment.

name: Energy Imbuing
description: An Energy Imbuer could be wearing a WMD and you would never know it. Their ability enables them to 'charge' any object with raw energy. Once the energy is in the object, the way it is first released will determine the way the remainder will be released. The result? Rods that release electricity on impact, rings that pack a kinetic punch, and so on. Now while anyone can use these objects, only the user reverse the process--deenergizing the objects to revitalize themselves.
summary: The ability to store your own energy in objects
strengths: Energy can be released (radiation, kinetic, heat, etc. )
You can reabsorb energy you have stored to revitalize yourself
Personal effects become weapons
weaknesses: Anyone can use an energized object
May not have enough energy to charge anything
Only one type of energy an object

name: Emotional Aura
description: With this ability, you produce an aura that effects those around you based on your mood. If you're in a joyful state, it increases the energy of you and those near you, and gives them a good mood. If you're disappointed or sad, it will cause others to feel sad. While angered, the aura becomes strong, and instead of sharing your emotions, it puts others into state of fear. A strong negative aura can cause others to be put into a state of shock.
summary: The ability to produce an aura which varies based on your current emotions
strengths: Joy increases the mood around you, and boosts the energy of you and others
Anger will create an aura that increases your strength, but will make others fear you greatly
All emotions effect those around you, and usually positively after both you and them
weaknesses: Great negative emotions can cause chaos around you, such as shaking of the ground, etc.
Friends may favor you for your ability, and not you as a person
Difficult to control, just as regular emotions are

name: Residual Energy Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to control energy and radition that remains in one place when its main source is no longer there. The user can see the residual energy and then able to make them more visible.  The energy/radiation won't have the effects that it had when it was whole. No radiation poisoning, No heat from energy.
summary: The ability to sense and control faint energies/radiation.
strengths: Control energy/radiation that is faint to the human eye.
Use psionic ghosts to talk about what the people they belong to said in that moment
weaknesses: The reactivation of multiple residual energies/radiations at once could cause a massive explosion.
Residual energies/radiations don't have the effects of its former sources.

name: Aura Ball
description: The ability to launch a powerful ball of your aura at an opponent, which hurts a lot
summary: The ability to launch a ball of your aura
strengths: May send opponents flying backwards
Hurts real bad(not you)
Powerful
weaknesses: Only damages human/creatures
Can only hurt if praciced (but will freak people out)
People will want to hang around you (may include stalkers)

name: Magic Mimicry
description: When you transform into your magic form, you are still human shaped but you will glow a different color, be slighty transparent, and crackle with energy. You can focus this energy into bolts, blasts, shockwaves, ect. It will have a different effect everytime you hit something with your energy. It could change it, bring it to life, destroy it, make it vanish, or something completely random. With time and practice you could probably contol the effect as long as it's within your limits.
summary: The ability to transform into magical energy
strengths: Your magic form looks cool
You can focus your energy with varying effects
It's mimicry, with more
weaknesses: Controlling the effects is very hard
Must be in magic form to use your powers
You have a limited amount of energy before you revert to human form.

name: Omnicast
description: Omnicast/transperiate is the ability to shape aura into whatever shape you can think of and harden it into an object. Then turn it back into aura when you're done with it.
summary: The ability to reshape and solidify aura.
strengths: Good for defense and attack.
It can be fixed or reshaped even after it's made.
Saves bundles on buying furniture and stuff.
weaknesses: Bigger objects take longer because it needs more aura to make.
Same as above but with heavier objects.
Omnicast friend statues don't talk.

name: Gadget: Power Gauntlet
description: You receive a metal gauntlet containing advanced technology that allows you to use three powers:  Electrical Emission (lightning from your fingers), Energy Fist (send shockwaves through the ground), and Electro Shielding (use electricity to create a shield around you).   The gauntlet has a limited power supply, but recharges itself using the kinetic energy of the wearer's movements.  Also, the gauntlet's origins are mysterious, possibly even alien. Very few people could repair this device.
summary: The ability to use a technologically advanced gauntlet in combat.
strengths: Allows you to use three different powers
Gauntlet uses its own power, not yours
Recharges with normal movements
weaknesses: Can run out of power temporarily
Not attached to you, could be lost or stolen
Difficult to repair, impossible to replace

name: Bio Magnetism Manipulation
description: Bio-magnetism is magnetism generated by the body and can be passed on to other objects or living things. If you put a bio-magnetic field around something/someone, that object/person can't touch anything/anyone else that has been bio-magnetically charged. This ability can also cover individual molecules as well.
summary: The ability to have a Bio-Magnetic field around you and to make anything else have the same Bio-Magnetic field.
strengths: Good for defense.
Master it. It can be use for offense.
weaknesses: Might cause some computer or mechanical problems if not mastered.

name: Psionic Re Animater
description: Anything you re-animate will do exactly what you tell it to do. Commands will be even understood by a re-animated insect. You can psionically infuse 10 human-sized subjects a day. Their size relative to you matters. You could re-animate 500 or more birds. Instead of making new re-animates, you could use this power to stop decay and make repairs to existing ones. Only someone with this power could try and wrestle control of your re-animates from you.
summary: The ability to re-animate dead things by infusing them with psionic energy.
strengths: Repairable and loyal servants that don't have to decay.
Someone needs this power to override control of your re-animates.
weaknesses: Psi re-animates are subject to powers that affect dead tissues.

name: Stamina Leech
description: A person with this power can absorb people's physical stamina. All the user needs to do is touch a person to absorb their stamina. They will feel weak and tired while you fill up with energy. Also, through practice, the user can also fire back stamina as a concussive energy blast. The effective range for this ability is at around 2 feet away. When directly touching a person, the person will be stunned and they will struggle to react, similar to being shocked by a taser.
summary: The ability to suck a person's physical stamina to fuel your own or fire a powerful blast
strengths: In hand-to-hand, this is useful
This can be used in mid-range combat by firing off your own stamina as a blast
If mastered, you don't need to directly touch someone to absorb their stamina
weaknesses: If you overuse your stamina blast, you will get tired
Doesn't work on machines
If you absorb too much stamina, it will kill people

name: Soundwave
description: You could make their heads explode, you could make their ears bleed. You could cancel out sounds and make sounds.
summary: The ability to make sonic sound blasts
strengths: You can fly
You can block
You can kill
weaknesses: None
None
None

name: Falling Potential
description: If you concentrate on any object, you can cause it to react as if it had suddenly stopped at the end of a 2000-foot fall.
summary: The ability to suddenly use stored kinetic energy and unleash it as if it had fallen from 2000 feet
strengths: Anyone would be foolish to mess with you, lest they become hard to recognize
I can open that safe for you
Three words, superbouncy bouncy balls
weaknesses: You would create a mess wherever you went
Not all things react the same to crashing into the Earth at terminal velocity
You don't actually make anything fly into the air, just react as if it had fallen from that height

name: Light Absorption
description: Sight is a person's strongest sense and without it, they are severely disabled. A Light Absorber knows this better than anyone. They drain all light from a 50-foot radius, making it totally pitch black. But, even though this power may blind others, the user can still see in the darkness.  Yet, this may come with a cost. Sometimes, the user absorbs ALL light--even background radiation. If so, then unless he learns to absorb the less harmful part of the spectrum, using this power poisons the user.
summary: The ability to absorb light energy harmlessly
strengths: Minimum concentration needed to generate a 50-foot radius of total darkness
Light Absorbers can still see in the dark (they also have either Night Vision or Lightless Vision)
Light Absorption can also be used to absorb light attacks with little to no harm
weaknesses: Cannot generate light, or manipulate the darkness they generate
Also pick up background radiation, thus poisoning self (unless you have adaptations to prevent it)
Letting absorbed light build without releasing some, often results in the user overheating

name: Lightning Vision
description: This power is like laser or heat vision, except that instead of lasers or heat coming out of your eyes, lightning bolts do
summary: The ability to electrocute enemies with your eyes
strengths: Can electrocute your enemies
weaknesses: Your eyes turn yellow after using this to much (this might not be a bad thing if you like yellow)

name: The Eye Of The Destroyer
description: You can even risk using it, but it does a lot of insane damage by firing a concentrated light beam of energy to disintegrate everyone and everything in your path until it dissolves into nothingness. In my idiom "Pain is in the eye of the destroyer".
summary: The ability to charge up and fire a huge devastating beam from your eyes straight forward.
strengths: Can have a potential desire to burn all who oppose you.
weaknesses: It'll take a lot of hours to charge up.

name: Heat Lightning
description: The user is able to turn heat from the surrounding into lightning that can be discharged from the body. The intensity and voltage of the lightning is dependent on the heat from the surrounding. The hotter the surrounding, the more powerful the lightning.
summary: The ability to turn heat into lightning
strengths: Heat is almost always present throughout the year
Any source of heat can be used
Can shoot bolts or streams of lightning
weaknesses: Can't use the power during winter
Can't use the power if you have a cold

name: Tachyon Force
description: Being imbued with Tachyon particles enables you to control tachyonic energy. Move, react and see faster than the speed of light. Become invisible to anyone who cannot stop time even when you are not moving. Dodge lightning and lasers. You can nullify teleporters. If something makes contact with you, solid, fluid or energy, it will either be metabolized, disintegrate or explode. Time travel may be possible.
summary: The ability to control tachyon particles
strengths: Move faster than the speed of light
Become invisible, impalpable and invulnerable at the same time
Cause things to disintegrate or explode
weaknesses: You are not able to move at less than lightspeed unless you revert to normal
Reverting to normal takes a monumentous amount of concentration
No control over what happens when you make contact with something in your tachyonic form

name: Healing Bomb
description: You could heal anyone, one bomb at a time. Take a second to infuse mud with your healing energy. Your healing bomb explodes on contact with any living thing. You could heal injuries, sickness, replace limbs. You can heal your teammates and repel enemies away from them. You will be an irreplaceable ally.
summary: The ability to turn a ball of mud into a instantaneous healing explosive
strengths: Completely heal anyone in an instant
Anyone caught in the blast radius will be instantly healed of their injury, illness.
You get to throw mud and make pretty sizeable explosion
weaknesses: Could accidentally heal enemies
Need to treat mud with your healing energies to make the bomb work
Bombs don't damage people but does throw them off their feet & does property damage

name: Lightning Vortex
description: One hand becomes positive, the other negative. Electricity will start to flow between both hands and your body. The longer you can keep the circuit going the stronger the final blast will be. Ex: 1 minute can destroy a house while 1 hour can destroy a town. Maximum destructive power is a full city which takes five hours. All that will be left of whatever is hit will be a crater. While charging the user's body will be immune to all harmful electrical effects.
summary: The ability to charge up electricity then fire it off in a blast
strengths: You can destroy enemy bases from a long distance away.
weaknesses: If your circuit is broken by an someone else your body will get huge amounts of electricity running
(cont) rampant through it and you will most likely die.
It takes a long time to get to maximum charge.

name: Heaven's Light
description: You raise your hands towards the sky and say the following words: Heaven release thy wrath!  And as the last word leaves your mouth the sky unleashes a beam of pure light on the chosen location you had in mind, making an explosion when it hits something within the radius of the blast (100 feet).
summary: The ability to make a divine light explosion.
strengths: Great to send those who form a treat against you on a holiday.
You can blast anything at any time at any location.
Light also blinds those who prefer darker locations.
weaknesses: If they interrupt you when you are saying the words, the attack is canceled.
You can't hit your target if there is no sky.
If you think about yourself while saying those words you WILL kill yourself.

name: Electrostatic Charge
description: Electrostatic Charge is a unique ability. The user can produce massive amounts of electricity from their body--up to 300,000 volts, which is enough to kill 10 men. But, they can only put this into metal. Therefore, if they have no metal, they cannot release any electricity.
summary: The ability to charge metal with electricity by touch
strengths: Up to 300,000 volts
Electrified swords, iron pipes, etc.
Can recharge batteries
weaknesses: Can only release electricity into metal
Can only absorb half of what you generate
Must touch metal

name: Big Bang
description: With this power all you would have to do is point at an object and yell BANG! the object would create an explosion that damages all matter in a three yard vicinity of that spot leaving a black hole leading to oblivion or command the hole to suck in all matter and stop after the things you don't want are gone. Then all you would have to do is concentrate on what you want in place of the hole and you just and you just created a whole object out of nothing.
summary: The ability to obliterate one or many objects in one area and fill it in with your own creation
strengths: You could destroy an entire evil fortress or superhero headquarters in a mere moment
You could create impossible things
You can start the world anew and rule it
weaknesses: The more mass you destroy and create the more of your energy you waste
You can't use this ability to recreate yourself in total perfection because you will be destroyed
You can't use it on the time space continum or everything will fall apart

name: Laser Vision
description: One with Laser Vision can shoot lasers out of their eyes. There are seven different colors of lasers you could shoot. Red, blue, yellow, pink, white, black and green.  Red lasers burn things with extreme heat. Blue lasers vaporize things. Yellow shocks things. Pink kills things. White heals things. Black kills things. Green makes nature-like things appear.  There is a firing limit of 10 lasers a day.
summary: The ability to shoot lasers from your eyes
strengths: You can finally be FIRING YOUR LAZOR!
You can heal your friends.
You can burn/shock/vaporize/lill the Villain.
weaknesses: Your lasers bounce off mirrors and other things that reflect light.
Accidently healing the Villain/Bully/BadGuy you're fighting. Accidently killing people you like.
Limit of amount per day fired.

name: Natural Probability Replay
description: This ability allows one make something that does not appear normally and makes it become more naturally. Here is a perfect example. Lightning strikes near you and then you use this ability. Now, you can summon lightning as reoccurring thing. As in, It will happen more often and probability will accept it as the norm, and the user can have control over that as well.
summary: The ability to make things that do not occur naturally become common place and control it.
strengths: Make things that do not usually occur in nature or probabilty become common place.
Have full control over these new natural phenomenons.
Make something that happen only once become a natural occurrence.
weaknesses: You can only control new occurrences not nature or probability itself.

name: The Animal Glyphs
description: The day you were born and the position of the stars determine the twelve animals that not only describe you but reside within. Twelve Glyphs beamed into your brain represent the twelve animals. Then all you do is draw the glyphs wherever even in midair with your finger. However depending on the quality and work put into the glyphs determines the power and duration of the transformation.
summary: The ability to draw two glyphs each representing an animal then you transform into a combination of the animals.
strengths: Possibility of having twelve awesome animals at your disposal.
If you can draw well then the power of the transformation is doubled
The combined animals becomes stonger then just one alone
weaknesses: Possibility of having twelve bad animals at your disposal.
Takes time to do not good in a sneak attack
If you cant draw then the power will be halved.

name: Acid Spark
description: It may sound bizarre, but you can fire light-green corrosionic bolts of energy from your fingertips or the palm of your hands which could dissolve through anything and even melt off a person.
summary: The ability to fire green electrical bolts that will burn through anything.
strengths: Weird new electrical power to have.
weaknesses: Doesn't work in water.

name: Lateral Repulsion
description: A person with this power can cause anything they touch to become charged to repel anything from it like a magnet. The effect can be undone by touching it again. Like lateral magnetizer, heat has no effect on the repulsion. You can fly with this power by charging your hands to push the ground/air or alternatively use this to blast away people. Newton's 3rd law applies when using this power so you need to be careful to prevent backlash. You can selectively change the amount of repulsion possible.
summary: The ability to cause surfaces you touch to repel objects similar to a magnet
strengths: You can selectively use this power on only your hands to fly by pushing the ground
Blast things away by charging both hands then counterbalancing
Touch an object to protect it from ever coming in to human contact again
weaknesses: Very hard to undo your own effects except for the ones on your own body
Brute strength can break through repulsion
Newton's 3rd law applies when using it--could be bad or good

name: 1000 Shotguns

summary: The ability to fire 1000 energy blasts from one's sleeve
strengths: Can blast enemies into submission with a barrage of blasts.
weaknesses: Smaller sleeves might as well not even be used.
Will always be in sets of 1000.
Yelling out 'Fire' will get repetitive.

name: Mana Manipulation
description: You can create energy constructs for nearly any purpose, usually creating platforms to levitate yourselg and others, beams to grab enemies, and circular blasts to knock enemies back.

make platforms like stairs or elevators
make slides
