Reversing it causes it to travel more easily through insulators and conductors with high resistivity, but they aren't protected from the ill effects of electrical breakdown and reversed electricity can be stopped by very good conductors. Oh, and you can actually damage the human body.
summary: The ability to make the electricity choose the path of most resistance.
strengths: Body fat, bone marrow and sometimes the skin are very vulnerable against this power.
You can make electricity easily arc through the air, even through vacuum.
You can make electricity travel through and burn/damage glass, rubber, paper,...
weaknesses: Unless you have great electrical knowledge, the effects may be unpredictable and backfire.
It can be difficult to affect unpredictable electrical surges, like those of electrokinetics.
It doesn't work on bioelectricity.

name: Ultraviolet Light Absorption
description: The user is able to absorb ultraviolet energy given off by the sun. The user is then able to fire bolts or beams of ultraviolet energy from the ultraviolet light that has been absorbed. The ultraviolet light that has been absorbed must be released within 5 minutes or the ultraviolet energy that is stored in his or her body will start to destroy their body
summary: The ability to absorb ultraviolet light and fire bolts or beams of ultraviolet energy
strengths: Ultraviolet light is ever present due to the sun.
weaknesses: No power during the night
Will destroy the user's body if the energy is not released

name: Maxwell's Demon
description: A person with this power is able to create "heat differences" creating areas of hot and cold at will but slowly. This power also allows them to generate electricty using the thermoelectric effect. This power does not influence items to be hot or cold directly but actually causes barriers where only high energy or low energy atoms can pass through. In effect, this power can also theoretically shield you from energy attacks as well.
summary: The ability to separate molecules based on their vibrational energy thus creating areas with different temperatures
strengths: Can make areas of hot or cold
Generate electrictiy
Shield from energy based attacks
weaknesses: Needs to study physics to use this power properly
Can't control electricity directly only generate it
Power takes time to take effect

name: Sui Generis Manipulation
description: A person who possesses this power has the ability to conjure an energy capable of totally annihilating everything under the definition of energy. Named after the Latin term "Sui Generis", the properties and behaviour of this energy are inexplicably one of a kind and is therefore unique to each person using this ability. The transformation and manipulation of the energy conjured lies only on the will of the conjurer.
summary: The ability to conjure an energy that can annihilate all other forms of energy.
strengths: Eliminate all other forms of energy ranging from sound to soul.
The conjured energy will always be unique from person to person like a finger print.
Only the conjurer has the ability to manipulate, transform, absorb, and utilize the energy.
weaknesses: This power requires a high level of concentration and stamina because the energy easily dissipates.
Requires extreme caution, kill anyone on contact -- includes the user of this ability.
Energy easily dissipates in nanoseconds because of all the energy in the universe.

name: White Hole
description: A white hole that cannot be entered from the outside, but can exude matter and light. One can use this for destructive purposes, creating a wormhole that releases matter and energy. The user is immune to its effects and can even create a warp tunnel to travel instantly to any location he or she wants.
summary: The ability to open up an ivory-colored wormhole.
strengths: Wormholes for destructive purposes
Worm hole to travel instantly to any location you want
Immune to its effects
weaknesses: None.

name: Negating Energy Beam
description: This power is really effective if you're a firefighter. It is the type of power to put out suns because it is heat and light together. This power can be used in battles, because what would be the point if you would be killed by some thug. It only has one weakness: you must be close to the source of energy to perform this power.
summary: The ability to shoot a ray of energy that eliminates any source of heat, light, or sound energy.
strengths: Good for battle.
Very powerful.
Effective against heat, light, or sound energy.
weaknesses: Must be close to the source of energy.

name: Aura Dissipation
description: Aura is a subtle force outside our bodies. Most of the time, it is described as an external 'energy-like' colored presence, though auras vary in many characteristics most of them have very amazing abilities. A person with this ability has the power to make such auras vanish or be destroyed; thus eliminating all potential threat from abilities emanating from these auras.
summary: The ability to make other people's aura vanish.
strengths: Instantly destroys the presence of other people's aura.
Your own aura is immune to this ability.
weaknesses: Has no other offensive use other than eliminating auras.
Will cause a bit of pain if reflected back to you.

name: Life Force Block
description: The ability allows the user to temporarily immobilize any other being. The effect ceases after a few hours. This also gives the victim an appearance of death. It can also act as a minor energy blast that damage solid objects.
summary: The ability to use one's inner energy to temporarily stop the flow of life energy of another being.
strengths: Immobilizes living beings or spirits.
Long time until the effect wears off.
weaknesses: Doesn't affect any other form of energy.

name: Explosion Stare
description: If you look at something for more then 3 seconds, the object you are looking at will explode. The only exception is for liquids and non-inflammable gases. It will work on solids, energy (energy blasts, lightning, forcefields), or inflammable gases. Just don't stare at something or someone you don't want to SEE die. If your mind goes out of focus and you're just looking at something, then that doesn't count. Your mind actually has to be staring at it, not just blankly looking at it.
summary: The ability to stare at something and it will explode.
strengths: Solids, energy, and special gases will explode if you stare at them for too long.
You can blast through anything, even forcefields.
You will scare people away, so you can win almost any fight.
weaknesses: You could destroy stuff that you don't want to destroy.
If you stare at a girl's butt too long, the girl will explode and you will never have sex with her.

name: Forced Reincarnation
description: If someone crosses you, you can make them disappear into an inanimate object like a lamp, tv, food etc. Any damage to the object they will feel. In electrical devices they can slightly communicate but only in low whispers. If eaten as food, the person that ate them will hear them until thoroughly digested out. If their "prison" is perfectly intact, they will remain there for the rest of their natural life then silenced forever.
summary: The ability to banish someone into an inanimate object
strengths: Make someone disappear into objects
weaknesses: You can hear their whispers if in electric appliances or if eaten

name: Animal Trainer
description: Never fear animals again! This power works by projecting a 30 foot radius of energy that causes any animal to be loyal and friendly to you. Once within your radius, the effect on the animal is permanent. While you can't speak with your animals, you can communicate at a basic level by pointing and using hand gestures. With time and skill, they'll even serve and protect you. Just think of the possibilities! Eagles, lions, whales, and the ferocious three-toed sloth--you name it.
summary: The ability to cause any animal to be tame and loyal to you.
strengths: Never get mauled by an animal
Build an army of angry chimpanzees
Snakes, spiders, scorpions, rattlesnakes--they're all friendly towards you!
weaknesses: Restricted to animals only (doesn't work on pissed off humans)
You can't speak with the animals--just basic gestures

name: Astral : Mantra Plane.
description: This power allows the user to access the Mantra Plane. If the user meditates in the Mantra Plane one can highten their senses and physical prowess to the zenith of human potential. It also powers up any other powers the user has. It also allows the user to gather mantra energy which powers up. It also allows the user to make contracts and summon the several beings living on the Mantra Plane.
summary: The ability to access the mantra plane
strengths: One can attack with a mantra energy which can be used in different ways out the body.
One can summon beings for help
One can train themself to the zenith of human potential
weaknesses: The beings can choose to break their contract if the user is either weak or evil
The mantra energy varies in power depending on the way it's used so it's not very reliable
The mantra energy could overload if not balanced

name: Life Charges
description: You can use this to get any powers they had which were magical and thus bound to their soul you can also put the soul into another body or trade it to get another soul which you could resurrect but you need a empty body that is not too badly damaged you only keep their powers while you have their soul stored inside you and transmitting a soul into another body may cause a change their personality due the host bodies different brain chemistry and metal aptitude. Ability needs line of sight
summary: The ability to kill people to steal their life energy
strengths: Kill your foes by ripping out their souls
Gain your enemies magical powers
Resurrect your allies
weaknesses: Your friends may change in personality and intelligence
Power corrupts
People may sense a great evil from you

name: Injectiplode
description: This ability gives you the power to inject a portion of your own energy into any object that causes the object to explode when a physical contact occurs with it. The force of the explosion is determined by how much energy you injected into the object.
summary: The ability to inject an energy into any object that causes the object to explode when a physical contact occurs
strengths: You can set up traps
You can inject your energy into any object and throw it at your enemies
weaknesses: If you make a physical contact with the object you injected your energy into, it will explode

name: Energy Immunity
description: Any power or attack that uses, controls, steals, and/or removes pure energy of any kind will not affect someone with this power.
summary: The ability to immune to any energy-based power or attack
strengths: You're immune to a large number of attacks and powers.
You can still utilize almost all of your energy-based powers.
Con: Powers that affect mass but not energy will still affect you.
weaknesses: Bullets, knives, and fists can still hurt you.
Allies cannot lend you their raw power.
You won't gain energy from your own energy-draining powers.

name: Clothing Power
description: A person with this power gets more abilities relative to the amount of clothing they wear and the type of clothing worn. For example, wearing sunglasses gives you laser vision and wearing a scarf gives you cryokinesis. Different brands affect the type of power. You can develop a varied set of powers by mixing and matching articles of clothing. However, you lose abilities as your clothing is destroyed. Earrings, rings, and other decorative items are also considered as clothing.
summary: The ability to gain abilities depending on the type of clothing you wear
strengths: By switching clothes, you can access a lot of powers
You can get multiple powers by wearing different combinations of clothing
Wearing multiple shirts on top of each other gives you multiple powers
weaknesses: Sometimes, to get the ability you need, you must wear embarrassing outfits or cross-dress
If your clothes are destroyed, you can't use the ability until you get the same clothes again
You need to have a large wardrobe

name: Sk: Phantom Creation
description: This ability allows the user to steal potiential energy in order to create phantoms in which the user can control them. The phantoms take the form of the things the potiential energy came from or the user can combine them in order to create a super phantom. The user can use his own potiental energy to create a phantom, but the user won't be able to move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to materialize shadowy kinetic-energy phantoms.
strengths: Create phantom to serve you
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Spatial Gunfire
description: This ability gives the user limited manipulation of space. When the bullets are constructed they can be directed for arcs, curves, high speed ricochet, zig zag, and aerial attacks. This ability also allows the user to stand upside down in midair. Other objects and debris which are energized by touch can also be directed. Spatial fields can also be created to trap targets in 'rooms' of bullets and shrapnel.
summary: The ability to direct energized bullets in your vicinity.
strengths: Thrash enemies in tight spaces.
Selected targets have no means of escape. Only entry but no exit.
Your personal spatial field will repel your own bullets and debris.
weaknesses: May trap teamates if not careful.

name: Aerodynamic
description: You can fly up high in the air toward the skies, completely surround yourself with a sphere of electric exploding energy damaging the enemy if he or she is in range of the explosion. While electricity surrounds you, you can launch yourself towards the foe. That'll shock all enemies in one direction, then the other, bouncing against the edges of the floors and walls a couple of times.
summary: The ability to surround yourself with exploding electricity, damaging anyone that gets nearby.
strengths: Works great against water-type adversaries.
weaknesses: Won't work while indoors.

name: Heavy Thunder
description: This ability allows you to doubles the weight of everything you hit with Heavy Thunder (green lightning bolts). Using this power you can knock down someone easily, turning him so heavy that he can't stand his own weight. If you shoot something that is 70 pounds, it will become 140 pounds, then 280, etc. You can focus the Heavy Thunder energy into a green electrical knife, and every time you cut someone with that knife he will bleed twice faster.
summary: The ability to shoot green lightning bolts that doubles the weight of things.
strengths: A powerful ability, can knock down someone easily.
The Knife Mode can make someone bleed to death in seconds.
weaknesses: Works slower on people with Super Strength.
When you stop using the Knife Mode you get unable to use the Heavy Thunder for 3 hours.

name: Plasma Bomb
description: You are able to use the most powerful plasma, with which you will take down any foe.
summary: The ability to shoot orbs of hot and radioactive plasma
strengths: Make a powerful weapon
Take down even the hardest enemy
weaknesses: Dangerous
Hard to conrol

name: Edible Energy Emitter
description: This ability allows you to generate an energy ray, beam or wave that transforms anything it touches into a substance that looks similar as the original but is edible. For instance, wood may be turned into chocolate swirled to look like wood.
summary: The ability to generate an energy ray that transforms any matter into a similar-looking edible substance
strengths: Never starve (and/or end world hunger)
Eat your way out of any prison
Eat enemies
weaknesses: Once changed matierials cannot be reverted, unless your power develops
Can't decide what KIND of food it turns into (color, texture and shape determine this)
People always begging you to make stuff into food for them

name: Black Hole Generation
description: With this power, a person can cause an atom to turn into a small black hole, which grows and has greater then normal gravity. It only affects things you allow it to, but it does more than just pulling things in and spaghettifying them -- time slows down and all powers are distorted beyond use. It stores Hawking Radiation, which becomes heat, light, concussive force, radiation, etc. Once you stop maintaining it or walk out of range, it explodes in a blast of Hawking Radiation.
summary: The ability to create black holes.
strengths: Very destructive.
Powers are messed up -teleporters can't get away and you can't be mimicked.
It only affects things you allow it to.
weaknesses: Lack of control.
Like real black holes, things have to be close until they gain mass.
Apart from destruction, it's almost useless.

name: Limit Transcendence
description: Simple. If you have a power that specifically disallows something (for example, if you have a magnetism power that specifically says in its description "you can't lift non-magnetic metals), then at will you can gain a power to do just that.
summary: The ability to gain a power from what you can't do
strengths: Get a lot of new powers from old ones
Get to do things even your powers say you are unable to do
weaknesses: You only get new powers based on the wording of your old ones
Your old powers have to be off this site or somewhere where they have a worded description
Immortality- you can't die, so you can at will get the ability to die. Kind of pointless.

name: Holy Power: Avenging Thunder
description: With this power you can shoot a powerful laser from your fist, or shield. This laser has the same amount of energy as a small star and destroys everything on its path. You can shoot this laser many times in great speed, but it attacks only forward, making you vulnerable.
summary: The ability to shoot a powerful laser from your fist, or Avenger Shield, with the same energy of a small star.
strengths: You can shoot a powerful laser in great speed from both hands.
This power has an accurate targeting, and a great field of range.
weaknesses: Attacks only forward, making you vulnerable from other directions.
Energy Absorption or Suppression powers
The destruction left behind has to be cleaned up by SOMEONE

name: Human Damper
description: When you activate this power, it progressively converts your kinetic energy into heat, effectively dampening your movement. It only applies to the kinetic energy stored in your motion, so bodily functions aren't affected. Your body also becomes highly resistant to heat, but if the heat is too high, you will burn. You can only transform your own energy. If you want to affect someone or something else's energy, you need to be solidly connected to them so their kinetic energy is shared with you.
summary: The ability to dissipate the kinetic energy stored in your body as heat.
strengths: You can slow down more easily.
You can even decrease your terminal velocity if you are falling.
You have some form of heat resistance.
weaknesses: If the heat you produce is extremely high, you will burn. Also, you are not fire resistant.
If you want to dampen something else's speed, you need to be attached to them.

name: Plasma Vision
description: Plasma is a state of matter where the molecules have extremely high levels of energy. Good examples of plasma are fire and lightning. This power allows the user to fire bolts of plasma from their eyes to hurt enemies, burn down doors, etc.
summary: The ability to fire bolts of plasma from one's eyes
strengths: Can utilize something highly dangerous with your eyes.
Can turn this power off to minimze accidents.
weaknesses: Will still hurt you if you fire it at yourself.
Destroying a nice pair of sunglasses.

name: Flow Reversal
description: The reversal of Energy, as in Heat, Kinetic, and so on. This also means mild manipulation of movement in objects and so on.
summary: The ability to redirect energy
strengths: Ability to redirect several types of energy.
Stem the flow of small rivers.
Negate effect of mild radiation.
weaknesses: Cannot redirect Lightning or stop objects more than twice own mass.
Requires a degree of knowledge of Energy Types.

name: Singularity Shapeshifter
description: You can turn into a vaguely humanoid exposed core of a black hole. You don't affect gravity, but gravity control has no effect on you. Any matter touching you will have its atoms ripped apart. Any energy beam striking you will be harmlessly scattered. You are a walking somewhat man-shaped breakdown of reality, so reality bending powers can't affect you directly. A probability controlling power could affect the world around you, hindering you, but not you.
summary: The ability to become a singularity, that is the core of a black hole.
strengths: Immune to direct attack.
Villains will leave their best gear at home if they're facing you.
Or just retire from villainy.
weaknesses: You can't save people or important objects using physical contact. No hostage rescue.
You have the potential to be worse than a bull in a china shop.
Destruction is your first, middle and last name.

name: Blessing Of Zeus
description: Zeus is the greek god of the skies. His blessing allows you to gain powers over his realm. You can create bolts of lightning strong enough to destroy a car or topple a small building. You can even call down lightning from the sky to charge you or your weapon. Also, Zeus's symbol is the eagle, so controlling eagles is now a simple extension of your will. You power is driven mainly by emotion, so watch out for lightning when you get upset.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Zeus
strengths: You have powers over the skies
Eagles are your servants
Lightning is incredibly powerful
weaknesses: You can't fly
Your emotions have more control over your powers than you do

name: Emf Manipulation
description: EMF or Electromotive force is what tends to cause current (actual electrons and ions) to flow. Manipulating EMF will make a change in voltaic cells, thermoelectric devices, solar cells, electrical generators, transformers, and even Van de Graaff generators, ceasing them or overloading them. Electromotive Force is smiliar to a magnetic field. In other words, one can use this to manipulate batteries, making them dead or to overloading them.
summary: The ability to manipulate Electromotive Force
strengths: Manipulate batteries. Hey, at least you won't have to go buy new ones.
A very unique power.
weaknesses: You do not have control over the Magnetic Field, just a certain kind.

name: Holy Power: Prismatic Volley
description: Using the Gunslinger Pistols, you absorb a small amount of the universe tissue, focusing and comprising it inside the Pistols, and then releasing it against your enemy, attacking him with every element of the universe and destroying your target completely. This power wastes a regular amount of energy, and its range is safe and precise.
summary: The ability to shoot a volley of shots from all existing elements in the universe, destroying the target completely
strengths: Powerful, Safe and Precise, this ability is the perfect elemental power.
Doesn't wastes too much energy.
With all elements in the universe, its nearly impossible to survive this power.
weaknesses: Takes a few seconds to get all the elemental energy.
Using this power too much can cause damages to the universe tissue and cause weird things to happen.

name: Perceptible Magnetism
description: Magnetic fields are all around us, whether in the earth's magnetic field, around electrical objects, even very small ones in the brain. This power allows you to see those fields visually as colours, and so be able to tell things like the strength and direction. Always know exactly where North is. Be able to sense electrical equipment. Know in advance if an enemy is going to use a magnetic manipulation attack. The possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to see the magnetic field lines around you as colour gradients.
strengths: Always navigate perfectly with no need for a compass. Could be helpful with Flight.
Sense where and how powerful electrical equipment is.
Preempt magnetic superpowers by sensing disturbances in local magnetic fields.
weaknesses: No control over magnetic fields, just perception.
Could be distracting, but focus is needed to use it so you probably wouldn't notice it normally.

name: Spark Manipulation
description: Spark manipulation is similar to lumokinesis, but is not that at all. It is when you can stun your enemies using the sparks, making them blind or unconscious. You can also make yourself into a beam of sparks, and can shift your size and shape at will. You can also sting opponents when your sparks hit them
summary: The ability to create an aura of extremely bright light around yourself.
strengths: You cannot be harmed while in spark form
Your enemies will not be able to see you after your attack
The stings can cause extreme pain to opponents
weaknesses: Spark form only lasts for about 5 minutes
When in spark form, you cannot fly
Enimies can still defeat you if not fompletely blinded

name: Vampirism Immunity
description: That is, any power that takes or drains energy, blood, etc will have no effect on one.
summary: The ability to be immune to powers that take from one directly
strengths: Shadowulf1's Vampirism series will not affect you (not even Vampirism: Superpowers).
weaknesses: This power makes you immune to even allies draining power from you.
You can't even use a power to drain yourself to boost an ally.

name: Marble Charge
description: You can only create the explosive marble from your palm, so if something happened to them, your power would be useless. You also can only create them in ten second intervals. The explosion from them is equal to a grenade. The marble can either be detonated when your enemy steps on it, on your command, or if something hits it. There is no expiration date for the marble and there is no limit of marbles you can make and detonate at once.
summary: The ability to create marble sized balls from your palm and leave them to explode when you want.
strengths: The marbles will never run out.
Can act like a mine, grenade, or impact bomb.
You can potentially explode a million of these marbles at once anywhere in the world.
weaknesses: If you accidentally step on one on them you are as good as dead.
You need at least one hand to create the bomb.
They will not detonate when wet.

name: Ability Supercharging
description:
Ability Supercharging allows you to supercharge other people's abilities, thus making them even more powerful.
It can also be used to generate and fire a concussive energy blast.
Supercharged abilities also sometimes have a secondary effect(EG. Supercharged Superspeed charged enough to the speed of light theoretically allows time travel).
summary: The ability to supercharge other people's abilities. Has a secondary use.
strengths: Supercharge your ally's ability to make them more powerful.
Fire a concussive energy blast.
weaknesses: Sometimes activates on it's own.

name: Fluid Containment
description: With this power, one can create specialized forcefields which will allow solid objects and energy to pass through, but fluids will not. However, fluids can pass through if sealed within a container.
summary: The ability to create a barrier blocking the passage of fluids, but not solids.
strengths: Perfect for an airlock; there will be no loss of atmosphere, with no interruption to function.
With experience, fields can be moved and made into any size or shape.
Has a huge number of uses.
weaknesses: Not as useful as a defensive or containment field.
Only works for fluids.
Fields suffer the same limitations as normal forcefields.

name: Rapacity Rebound
description: Imagine you get an awesome new power and then it's stolen. Of course you want revenge - with this ability, the stolen at power triggers itself to harm the robber. I. E: Your power to shoot bullets out your hand gets stolen. Now whenever the thief tries to use the power, he shoots bullets at himself. This only works on powers, not states/forms of being. E.g. it works on eye lasers, but not on form/summoning a dragon. They can still use the power, only it does half damage
summary: The ability to automatically trigger a power that's been stolen to work against the thief
strengths: REVENGE!
The power does double damage to the thief
weaknesses: You don't actually get your power back.
Only works on stolen powers, not states or forms of being.
They still get to use the power

name: Shock Blades
description: It's a weaponry superpower that takes the form of a razor-edged circular saw blade that's covered in dangerous electricity. The shock blades can be generated and thrown in any direction. The blades swirl around the opponent, slicing and shocking them.
summary: The ability to throw electrical, circular saw blades.
strengths: Can be hazardous to bird and water-type enemies.
weaknesses: Will not work against metal manipulators.

name: Sun Ray Nutrition
description: You wouldn't need to eat because you would get all the energy you need from the sun. You could live without food as long as there is light.
summary: The ability to gain energy from the sun.
strengths: Never need to eat again.
Can get energy anywhere.
weaknesses: You can't stay indoors too long.
Cloudy days leave you with less energy.

name: Ultimate Tk(Light Speed)
description: A person with this power can send objects they touch to any direction at lightspeed. In effect it looks like the person is throwing lasers. Since the user can accelerate objects to lightspeed, the reverse is also true. They can slow down light enough to grab it with no ill effects when in contact. With practice(hopefully), you can also accelerate yourself to lightspeed.
summary: The ability to throw lasers or grab light
strengths: Throw lasers(actually objects at lightspeed)
Can deccelerate light enough to grab it/touch it.
You can accelerate yourself to light speed
weaknesses: Needs aim even with lasers
Needs projectiles to make lasers(but can use air)

name: Vampiric Matter Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to generate a sinister material that is design to feed on the energy that other matter to move. This makes the other matter inert and maybe even worse. The vampiric matter can absorb the matter's basic properties.
summary: The ability to create and control a form of matter that feeds on other matter's motion energy.
strengths: Create a dangerous matter that feeds on other matter to be more powerful.
Make all matter useless
Affects living creatures as well.
weaknesses: Does not possess special properties of other matter just how the matter moves.

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow State
description: With this power you can steal a person's shadow by touching it. You gain the person's powers, but you can only use them in the Shadow State. When you enter the Shadow State, your eyes turn black and you are surrounded by a dark aura. You can use the powers of all the people whose shadows you have stolen. But using the Shadow State has a cost. The darkness fills you with rage, and the shadows carry the memories of their original owners. Without practice, the rage and memories could consume you.
summary: The ability to steal people's shadows, allowing you to gain their powers by entering the Shadow State
strengths: In the Shadow State you have complete mastery over the powers you have gained
You can enter the Shadow State at will
Can be used with Shadow Traitor: you can steal a shadow for your army and gain its powers too
weaknesses: The rage and memories make it hard to control youself (think Avatar State)
Even with experience, prolonged time in the Shadow State can drive you insane

name: Rotating Shield
description: The forcefield created has a maximum radius of 100 metres. The shield is constantly and automatically rotating. The effect of the rotation is to decrease the damage inflicted to the shield itself. This allows the shield to last against more attacks in the long-run but takes up more power than your average force field.
summary: The ability to create a shield that rotates and spins areas of itself
strengths: Can take more hits in a longer battle.
75% less concentration needed to have the field spin than with a normal forcefield.
weaknesses: Takes up more power in the long run that could be used for other powers during the fight.
Normal nonspinning shield takes 20% less concentration to keep going than this shield.

name: Goldworks:The Box Of Power
description: The Box of Power has been known by many names over time. The Diabolical box, Pandora's box, The Box of Fate, and others. Within this golden box, an incredible, unimaginable power dwells, the power to grant near godhood. All who open this box are granted god-like powers and a realm. They will know what their realm is, because they will find a scroll stating what it is within the box. The box will endow you with godly energy, with which you can do as you wish.
summary: The ability to wield the Box of Power
strengths: Near god-hood(because you were once mortal, you can still be killed but it's very hard to do)
Powers over your realm
Other godly powers
weaknesses: Can still be killed
Not a true god
Too much power is bad for everyone

name: Energy Wrist Watch
description: With this power you have an irremovable watch that shoots energy beams on your wrist. The beams can be set to different power levels by turning the watch face with the lowest being burning and the highest being instant death. The watch is irremovable so an enemy can never steal it but you can't take if off either unless of course you lose this power.
summary: The ability to have a watch on your wrist that shoots energy beams
strengths: You can shoot powerful energy beams from your wrist watch
You can adjust the power levels of the beams
weaknesses: You can't take off the watch

name: Power Bearing
description: With this power the user can only be affected by a superpower or ability once. Say if the user gets hit by a energy blast, he can't be affected by the same blast again. The user can only negate three powers at once.
summary: The ability to only be affected by a ability/power once
strengths: The foe can't spam you with the same attack
weaknesses: This power only works if the user were hit by the power/ability
This power only allows you to negate three powers at once

name: Magician's Sight
description: The Magician's Sight is a tool used by many magicians. Basically, it lets you see the unseen. This includes auras, wards, invisible things, and you can see through any sort of disguise spell. You can also see force lines, streams of magical energy that run through the ground and sky.
summary: The ability to use the Magician's Sight
strengths: You can see things most people can't
Disguises won't fool you
You can see force lines
weaknesses: You can't do magic

name: Spark Flux
description: The user can focus their aura into a defensive electricity field with a 100m radius. It electrocutes all in that range. The user can share it's senses with the Spark Flux and when the user is surrounded by the Spark Flux, he/she is protected from most types of sensing.
summary: The ability to creat a web of aura generated electricity around the user
strengths: It is good for stealth missions, recon since it protects from most types of sensing including sound
It is good if the user is outnumbered by enemies in close range.
It only needs a small amount of aura to sustain.
weaknesses: While Spark Flux is at use the user is greatly vulnerable if it is surpassed.
It has a very short range.
The more injured the user gets the more energy the Spark Flux will take from the user.

name: Raiami
description: The Raiami or Lightning Net Technique, is an ability useful in the capture of enemies without having to kill them. After focusing your inner energy it is released from your hands in the form of a yellow lightning net that catches your opponent electrifying them into unconsciousness. Where most lightning moves fade after being used, the Lightning Net remains intact until the user releases it. This net will shock everything except the one who created it.
summary: The ability to create a net made of lightning that will bind and electrocute your emenies.
strengths: You can defeat enemies without having to kill them.
Enemies that are being electrified will not be able to use their powers.
Water based escape techniques will be innefectual against lightning.
weaknesses: It can only be used close up.
You can't stray too far from the net or it will dissapear.
A steady amount of your inner energy is constantly being used up to keep net in its form.

name: Laser Manipulation
description: With Laser Manipulation, one can amplify the characteristics of lasers. Examples include making a heat ray by changing the intensity of the laser or blinding foes by changing the brightness of a laser. One could change the coherency of a laser, making it change from a beam to making it spread out like normal light. A person with this power can be deadly with just a laser pointer or a CD player.
summary: The ability to manipulate the characteristics of lasers
strengths: Turn a CD player into a heat ray.
Change the coherency of a laser and make a flash, blinding foes.
weaknesses: You can blind yourself
You cannot emit lasers

name: La Force De Fourmi
description: When your enemy is much stronger than you, your aura flips around the difference and you become the stronger opponent
summary: The ability to become stronger than your enemy when he has more power than you
strengths: Be able to defeat who's normally stronger than you.
Good for an underdog, especially in betting
You temporally have awesome power
weaknesses: Lasts as long as you're fighting that enemy
The enemy needs to be stronger than you, someone equal or lesser in power can defeat you
You have to constantly weaken yourself in order to use this power

name: Split
description: When you use this power you create a dimensional rift that splits you into light and darkness forms. While in light form you are glowing white and can create solid light projections and light energy laser beams. In shadow form you have pale, blue skin and one black eye with an orange pupil. You can create shadow mist that poisons others; also you have sharp claws, can melt into liquid shadow, feed off the energy of the core of planets, and you can change form.
summary: The ability to spit into light and darkness forms
strengths: While in light form you can be a human flashlight
You spit into two bodys and control each seperately
In shadow form you can get stronger by feeding off the core of planets
weaknesses: Feeding will eventualy cause the planet to explode
Shadow form may scare people

name: Infamous Electric Karma
description: The way you use your lightning powers and the color it is, depends on your "karma". If you do good things, it is perceived as good karma and your lightning will be blue-colored. If you do bad things, your lightning will be red-colored. You can create electric shockwaves, grenades, lightning bolts, and other things.
summary: The ability to control lightning and electricity according to your karma.
strengths: Can heal people or kill them by sucking their energy out of them.
Can heal yourself and recharge your powers by absorbing electricity from electronics.
Can cling to objects which allows you to climb buildings easily.
weaknesses: Standing in bodies of water (pool, ocean, sea) will short circuit your powers and kill you.
Powers can activate accidently sometimes.
Setting things on fire.

name: Sound Storage
description: You can store the energy from sound waves in your body and fire that off as plasma blasts as needed. You can fire off the blasts with however much of the energy you've stored up as you want. The maximum amount of energy you can store is enough to destroy two two-story buildings that are consecutively placed. This power can only be gained by singing a full requiem while simultaneously playing a piano piece that lasts an hour. Both of them have to be done correctly and without any breaks.
summary: The ability to absorb the energy of sound waves in one's body and fire off the energy as plasma blasts
strengths: Enemies who are 100% sound-based.
The energy limit is only without other powers (good idea to have Infinite Energy Storage).
The piano piece will most likely be classical music (may be con if you hate classical music).
weaknesses: Some users are unable to stop absorbing sound and are effectively deaf.
Users cannot absorb sound that they emit.
How many easy hour-long piano pieces are there out there?

name: Birdblast
description: 1. It can destroy anything near at full blast.  2. Its very powerful.  3. It can burst your eardrums. 4. At any pitch it can still destroy.
summary: The ability to let out an extremly powerful ultrasonic scream.
strengths: Very powerful
It can burst eardrums
weaknesses: Can destroy anything near at full blast
At any pitch it can still destroy

name: Bio Cure
description: This power can absorb all pollution there is, but it can hurt the user depending who the user is. If they have used it most of there lives, absorbing hazardous wastes is a piece of cake. If the user is a minor or someone new to it, they could kill themselves. Also, shooting a massive beam of what was absorbed is the only thing a new user can do at first, but later they can do so much more, like giving that pure energy to other lifeforms.
summary: The ability to intake all kinds of pollution and release it in any kind of way.
strengths: Clear any pollution
Give life back to other beings
Save any life from dangerous pollution
weaknesses: The user can be killed by the pollution they intake
The amount of pollution and power they absorb can overwhelm and destroy the user
Eventually the body will be overwhelmed

name: Power Combo Controller
description: The ability to combine powers or separate powers in yourself or others. Powers that are combined are more powerful but are harder to use as well. Powers that come from a power being separated into more powers are only slightly weaker but are easier to control and take less energy to use. Not all powers can be separated into more than one power. This power can return powers that were affected by this power to normal. You must have all the parts of the previous power if the power was separated.
summary: The ability to combine or separate powers into new powers.
strengths: Combine powers into stronger versions.
Separate powers into multiple easier-to-use powers.
Can be used on anyone.
weaknesses: Combined powers are harder to control.
Separated powers are weaker the more the original power was separated.
New powers have both pros and cons.

name: Twilight
description: The ability allows you to change from your normal state into a twilight state, giving you the powers to step in ultra speed to shoot pure light out of your hands and eyes if you are in the light.  If you are in the dark, you become it, having the powers of the darkness. You will be able to move throughout shadows, open doors into the void and emit beams and shockwaves of darkness from your hands and body. Plus, you can control the enemies' fear.
summary: The ability to become the embodiment of fear and hope
strengths: Able to surprise the enemy
The look of you can scare the enemies
Plus the look of you can give hope when in the light
weaknesses: You have a weakness: the time it takes for the sun to rise and set, you have no powers
The state you are in in the dark can be terrifying to the people you are protecting
This power is so cool that noone will want the other powers

name: Transferable Eyesight
description: Your normal sight and any other vision modes can see through another set of eyes. These eyes can be a doodle of disembodied eyes to the eyes of a living creature. The highest levels of this power let use vision-based powers(i. E. Laser eye beams) through a set of other eyes. If the other eyes you're looking through are damaged in any way you instantly see through your own eyes again.
summary: The ability to transfer all your modes of vision to another set of eyes.
strengths: See through anything that is or has a set of eyes. Paintings,toys,photos,etc.
The highest level of this power works other powers like heat vision.
weaknesses: Total mastery of this power is needed make it work with powers like laser eye beams.

name: Cargo Cult Deity
description: 'Cargo cult' is the term for a primitive group worshiping outsiders with more advanced technology, believing the technology to be magic. With this power, any technology you have/are using (note that even clothes count) is increased to the point that most of the people around you would consider it 'god-like. ' The technology retains, for the most part, its original function, just greatly extended in capability (a flashlight might turn night to day, but it won't shoot lightning or make bread).
summary: The ability to have technology that makes you seem like a god
strengths: Have advanced technology- powerful enough to look like a god (or at least a powerful magic user)
The more advanced the people around you, the more advanced you get
Most city-dwellers have fairly high standards, and everything in a city is technology.
weaknesses: You have to be in contact with whatever you're upgrading
Your power is entirely dependant on other people to make it, and their standards of what a 'god' is
The new technology won't be able to do random/new things, it has to be an extension of its old self

name: Myth Power: Plutos' Bounty
description: Plutos (Ploutos, Ploutus, Plutus), in Greek myth, was the god of wealth. As such, channeling him allows one to answer any question related to money (how much an item costs, stock investments, etc. ); however, they, themselves, have no need for it. All of society will treat them as though all the money in the world is at their disposal (anything with a price on it will be given to them, free of charge, no questions asked); in addition, their presence makes "food plants" produce more plentifully.
summary: The ability to channel Plutos' command over the essence of wealth, riches and bounty
strengths: Provide for yourself for life
Provide for your loved ones for life (and maybe feel a greater sense of charity)
Fame (knowledge of the workings of the economy ANYWHERE in the world)
weaknesses: Fame (knowledge of the workings of the economy ANYWHERE in the world)
People with MythPower: Demeter's Touch can sense your powers (hope they aren't villains)
People with MythPower: Tyche's Hand can sense your powers (hope they aren't villains)

name: Tactile Electric Charge
description: I originally thought of this ability as "Supercharger", but it can be for fighting as well. You can grab an enemy and throw him while your ability shocks him. You don't have to use your hand to use it, because you can use any part of your body that can hold or grip.
summary: The ability to release a powerful charge of energy just by holding on tightly
strengths: Recharger
Can damage or overload anything
weaknesses: Must be physically holding something
No range

name: Vampirism: Energy
description: This is the ability to absorb a type of energy into the body with no harm to oneself and convert it into sustenance and/or physical power; the energy may be any type (electricity, radiation, magical, psionic, etc. ) but it is almost NEVER all types. This ability is similar to normal Energy Absorption, but is distinguished by the fact that it absolutely MUST be accomplished by a bit to the source (though fortunately, due to this power, that does not threaten to harm the user)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the energy of others
strengths: Drain enemies' electronics, electrical appliances, generators, energy attacks, etc
Drain your foe's resources and get full and revitalized at the same time!
Though voluntary vampirism is by mouth, the body can also absorb energy attacks through the skin
weaknesses: Doesn't absorb enemy's life-force until the very HIGHEST levels
Requires an actual bite like a true vampire
May want to stick to energy producing superhumans (you'll look ridiculous biting a TV)

name: Electric Halo
description: With this ability, you generate a ring of bioelectrical energy around your head. This energy will shock any who touch it. The strength of the electrical energy, and the resulting glow of the halo, would depend upon your concentration. This will offer some protection from cranial assaults. It would also greatly increase the effect of any headbutts you give someone.
summary: The ability to generate a ring of bioelectrical energy around your head
strengths: Generates light to aid in seeing in darkness
Protects your head
Electric head butt
weaknesses: The glow oif the halo may increase detection on stealth or night missions
May attract the attention of a lot of religious nuts

name: Siren Song
description: When you make a sound, e. g. Yell or scream, you will be able to turn it into a destructive blast of energy which would render people unconscious from it. You also can play any instrument to channel this power.
summary: The ability to turn sound into destructive energy
strengths: Able to make a destuctive blast of energy from a small sound
You will be able to play any instrument
weaknesses: You need to make your own sound

name: Energy Blend: Shockwave
description: When you activate this power, pointing at any target releases a blue beam of electro-sonic energy from your finger. Electro-sonic energy is a mix of electricity and sound, so it negatively charges the target. The beam doesn't directly hurt the target, but anything the target touches will discharge the energy into the ground. The target will not only be charged with electrons, but their molecules will vibrate even faster than usual. Producing sound fuels the target's energy field. It's temporary.
summary: The ability to produce a beam of electro-sonic energy.
strengths: Make a beam out of your finger that turns the target into a capacitor.
The electronic field is increased when the target produces noise.
The effects are only temporary.
weaknesses: Will not hurt them directly, but they will shock everything that they touch.
Unless you have advanced control over the power, you will regret pointing at anything.
The effects are only temporary.

name: Lightning Blood
description: This power only works when the blood is outside of your body and is at the user's will. The blood will electrocute what it touches with around 5000 volts of electricity. You are immune to the electrical power created with this power.
summary: The ability to have what one's blood touches be electrocuted
strengths: If you're bleeding it is bad for your enemies.
weaknesses: You need to lose blood to use this power.

name: Cone Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. It gives you a better perception of movements. It also allows you to convert darkness into electricity. The darker it is, the more voltage you produce, but you can still shoot a fair amount of electricity in dim light. Alternatively, you can convert darkness into signals. By sending them to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you'll make them see what you see. When this power is activated, you will only see in one of three colors: red, blue or green.
summary: The ability to better see movements, convert darkness into electricity and allow people to see what you see.
strengths: You can perceive movements better than a normal human being.
You can electrocute someone if the light is dim enough.
By touching the back of the head of a human person, you can show them what you see.
weaknesses: You will only see in one color, and that color remains the same and can't be changed.
To see in all three colors while using this power, you need to acquire it multiple times.
You can't shoot electricity at all in very bright light.

name: Tactic Swap
description: This is the brother of my previous ability, Mode Swap, but this is a different version. Instead of switching any ability from physical to mental, it switches something different. A good example is if an army were to attack you; just switch them into a defensive phase and escape. Another good one: if you have the ability to release an energy blast, you can switch it into an energy barrier.
summary: The ability to switch any ability or personality from offensive to defensive or the other way.
strengths: Changes your or your opponent's abilities from offensive to defensive or the other way.
If you have a lot of abilities, you'll be able to open a whole new world of abilities.
weaknesses: You'll never know what will come out when switch the nature of your abilites.

name: Magnetic Resonance Vision
description: Simply what the description says, it doesn't get any simpler than that. You can get an MRI of anything instantly. That's it, just a slight modification of an age old superpower.
summary: The ability to be able to see things as if they were in an MRI scan
strengths: Similar to X-Ray vision
Has most of X-Rays Pros
weaknesses: To see the bad just contrast it with x-rays

name: Villain Verbosity
description: This power is aura. When at a distance of at most 40 feet and in your line of sight, opponents will feel compelled to describe as proudly as possible every action they are going to do before they carry it out, no matter how trivial ("scratching an itch") or not trivial as an opponent telling you the combination to a secret vault you didn't know they had, or a nasty superpower you didn't know they had. The "spell" of your power is broken if you are no longer visible or if you act aggressively.
summary: The ability to make opponents say what they are going to do before they do it.
strengths: No sneak attacks on you.
Opponents will reveal any tactics they are going to use against you.
Opponents may reveal they are bluffing.
weaknesses: You might be forced to dodge attacks without fighting back.
It is better not to know that an opponent has five different powers to kill you with.

name: Electricity Immunity
description: Electrical components, wires, cables, and anything else that holds or contains electricity will never shock a holder of this power.
summary: The ability to be immune to harm from electricity
strengths: Can repair damaged wiring without worry of death by electrocution.
Lightning is a form of electricity.
Electrokinetics might fear you, if you have other powers.
weaknesses: I can't think of anything that's bad about this power, but there might be.

name: Atomic Fission
description:
Ability to control the molecules of living things by using heat transfer from the source to the destination in an extremely high-level radiation emission stream. It will penetrate any substance at a molecular level and transform the object into any other object through the power of suggestion from the source. 

The negative side-effect is the energy level must be replenished with the heat of the sun over a period of 15 minutes to full strength.

strengths: Molecular transformation
Heat transfer from object to object
Super strength with the power of the sun

Can produce unstable amounts of radiation harmful to others

name: Cartoon Power: Dr. Vicktor
description: With this power you can make purple lightning come from the sky and strike buildings, people or anything else.

Purple lightning is so cool
weaknesses: Ben Ten fanatics might think you're some kind of monster villain because of the purple lightning

name: Essence Release
description: This ability puts stored essence gained through Hollowing Essence to use by allowing you to release it in an explosive manner. The properties of the stored essence determines the effect of the blast. For instance a creative essence might repair everything and essence of fear may cause all living beings in the area to become fearful.

strengths: Unleash a blast if stored essence
Multitude if possible effects
weaknesses: Not always a predictable power
Must have stored up essence to use.

name: Entropic Immunity
description: Also called entropic resilience this power grants the user the power to completely resist the adverse effects of entropy. The user of this power cannot have their energy chaotically spread out beyond use on a microscopic,macroscopic or any other scale. This means that the user can attack without having their blows reduced in power by entropy or suffer any disadvantage by an entropic attack. This power even eliminates NATURAL entropy's negative effects upon the user.

strengths: Resist entropic influence inflicted upon you.
Don't fear the dampenning of your attacks or harm to your body through entropy.
You are still free to use your own entropic based powers.
weaknesses: You can still be INDIRECTELY affected by entropy.
Not all that useful in most situations.
The enemy can still INCREASE the energy in their attacks.

name: Superpower Charge
description: With this ability, by being struck by any superpower, you gain power and energy, depending on how strong the power that struck you was. You can store this energy for as long as you want, and release it in a powerful blast of energy, or choose to save it, which will increase your mental and physical strength.
summary: The ability to charge your power by being struck by superpowers.
strengths: Every superpower used against you will benefit you
Save the energy of the powers you are struck by, or release them in a powerful, energetic blast
Being struck by powers makes you feel great, and has a nice taste
weaknesses: No additional benefit if someone is healing you, or shielding you, etc.
If you're never struck by a super-powered being
This is a passive ability (it's always active)

name: Creature Attractor
description: Unless it is controlled, you always give off a signal that indiscriminately tell any living creature in a large vicinity to come to you, except those from the same species as you. When sufficiently mastered, you can choose to attract only the species you want or only one specific creature, control the radius of your power, and even turn this power off. This power only draws the creatures' attention to you. They won't find you attractive; their feelings towards you are left to their nature.
summary: The ability to attract creatures from species other than yours.
strengths: You are the perfect bait! Just attract any creature into a trap.

name: Meteorbolt
description: The enemy doesn't stand a chance when you summon a meteor that is covered in thunderbolts. It comes down on him/her really fast and hard, and will fry them.

strengths: Brutal power to have.
Massive damage
weaknesses: Strange and brutal power to have.
Difficult to control & Collateral damge
Enemy might push you in its path

name: Solitary Sphere
description: Sphere is formed by hands and is made up of dark energy. A person hit by the sphere enters a deep coma and catatonic state. Once in coma the person is trapped in darkness and while a hour passes it wouls seem like one year.

Sphere absorbs other powers

Effects are not permanent
Does not work on people that also use darness as a power ect. Cloak

name: Warning Label Maker
description: Think of a object within visual range. Image a warning label on it. A warning appears on it and affects the object according to what you imagined on the label. Ex. You could put on a enemy's city-destroying laser that was just finished "must be on without firing for 3 months or laser will explode. " This power can make harmless things harmful(i. E. A cylinder of nitrogen gas with the right warning into something like nerve gas). Any label is made out of normal material.

Sabotage.

name: Delta Darts

strengths: Can even humiliate and/or beat your foe while they are stunned.
weaknesses: Won't work when they have their force fields or armor on.

name: Vampirism: Neuronal
description: Also called Neuronal Absorption, this is the ability to absorb the nerve impulses of others and convert it into sustenance and physical power; this may be used to facilitate an increase in speed, reflexes, agility, dexterity and cognition (anything requiring neuron activity). This absorption of neuron impulses leaves the foe temporarily paralyzed.

Foes with Superhuman Speed, Superhuman Reflexes, Superhuman Agility, etc,
weaknesses: The paralysis is sometimes permanent
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, family and friends won't want to be around you

name: Delete This A Infinity Turbine
description: You can use it to escape situations by charging your fists connected with cosmic power, surrounding yourself with an aura, while flying spinning towards your opponents to send them flying. You can also spin in place and suck in nearby enemies and/or projectiles. Opponents are thrown to the opposite side of the M. I. T. , while projectiles are neutralized.
summary: The ability to charge your fists with cosmic energy while flying spinning towards your opponent.
strengths: Can do a great deal of damage.
Fly through projectiles.
weaknesses: None.

name: Electrical Tentacles
description: The tentacles will reach from the user's head to their ankles and can generate electrical energy. The amount of energy differs for each user differs. The tentacles are black and the user can control the movement at will. The user of this power is the only one immune to the electricity.
summary: The ability to have tentacles that can electrocute what they touch
strengths: The tentacles are part of your body.

name: Blue Ray
description: Heal any blind person by emitting blue rays from your eyes. This blue rays restores one's sight without any complications or side effects.

strengths: Heal the blind and be the greatest eye doctor.
Your eyesight are immune to any known radiations!
weaknesses: None.

name: When You're Hot, You're Hot.

name: Lightning Familiar

name: White Assassin 2

description: You have limited control over energy. When you activate this power, pointing at any target releases a yellow beam of photo-sonic energy from your finger. Photo-sonic energy is a mix of light and sound, so it doesn't hurt the target. But it does bounce off in all directions, trapping air and making spheres that pop after travelling 40cm. name: Breakdown Voltage Manipulation
description: It's well known that electricity cannot (easily) flow through an insulator. That's true as long as the applied electrical voltage remains below a voltage level called the breakdown voltage of the insulator. If not, the insulator becomes electrically conductive. With this power, you can control that level. By lowering it, you can weaken an insulator, making it less effective to protect against electricity. By increasing it, you can make it more resistant to electrical breakdown.
summary: The ability to change the breakdown voltage of insulators.
strengths: Great if you have an electricity-based superpower since insulators won't be a problem anymore.
Increase the breakdown voltage of the air around you to protect yourself against lightning strikes.
Increase the breakdown voltage of your shoes to ground yourself.
weaknesses: It only works on insulators and partially on semiconductors, but not on conductors.

Fools enemies.

The mist could range from a small cloud cover, to an entire state, maybe country in range that it reaches, depending on persons personal skill with it. name: Ostracism (The Pariah Effect)
description: Also called the Pariah Effect, Ostracism is the ability to make subjects move (run/walk) towards or away from any subject of the user's choosing. One with this ability could keep enemies from getting too close, draw others to him as a shield from an attack, or the like. name: Children Of The Sun
description: You are a creature of Good and gain your powers from the Sun. Whenever the Sun is up, you could create wings, weapons, or blast light from your fingertips. name: Symbiotic Suits: Space Suit
description: The Symbiotic Space Suit, or Symbi Suit, is a living material that combines itself with you. It's a symbiote, so it does live on you, but it doesn't affect you negatively. You are able to see in different color spectrums. The suit sustains you by converting radiation into energy, so you do not need to breathe. name: Silence Is Golden
description: It's been said in dictionaries that silence is of great value. Some things are better left unsaid. Peace and quiet have immense value. Often the best choice is to say nothing. So, you have the ability to drain your enemies' voices, having a golden aura around you.

Make aluminum foil spark

You can choose to pixelize parts of the body or the whole body.

Freeze things

name: Prayer

While there are any multitude of effects that could happen each effect is based off a very specific prayer unique to that effect.
