name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Makes your adrenaline get so high which causes your energy to increase dramatically. Increases speed and agility, and also strenghth. But it is temporary and needs an recharge.
summary: The ability to have very high adrenaline rushes
strengths: Increases athleticism
weaknesses: You might not control yourself at times
Temporary boosts
Needs an recharge

name: Youth Drain
description: This ability you can drain the youth from anyone, making yourself young, and your victim will increase in age. The amount of youth energy drained is dependant for how long you stay in physical contact with your victim. This ability can easily kill old people and if not careful may revert you to state of prebirth; which will kill you.
summary: The ability to drain the youth from others, keeping yourself young.
strengths: Can stay young forever.
With this ability, you may be able to live forever.
weaknesses: All your victims will increase in age.
Can not give back the youth you have drained.
If not careful, might die from prebirth.

name: Stun Beam Vision
description: The people with this power is able to stun people with this power. Unlike the other visions which can potentially hurt people or kill people, this power will only stun the enemy. This power works, by stunning the enemies' neural synapses. This power has an effective range of 500 feet.
summary: The ability to stun enemies with your vision beam
strengths: Stun enemies instead of killing them (Stun now, ask questions later)
Will not accidentally kill your enemies
Easy to take down enemies with little or no superpowers
weaknesses: More powerful enemies might not be affected
The stun effect will wear off after time
Cannot hurt a person

name: Sensational Sound Burst
description: This ability is great for all those music lovers out there. This power is enough to destroy 2 buildings if let loose for the first time. The "side effects" of the beams on your victims depend on what the sound, word, or music is and there also could be multiple side effects. It must genuinely be your favorite sound. No recordings.
summary: The ability to let out a powerful concussion beam, or blast everytime you hear your favorite sound, word, or music.
strengths: Use your favorite sound for power
weaknesses: Must hear the sound to release it

name: Time To Eat
description: This superpower lets you think of an object you want eat without having to leave the house. Say, a small restaraunt in Korea has the best dumplings ever! All you have to do is think about em.
summary: The ability to make anything you want to eat appear in front of you, no charge.
strengths: You'll never be hungry again.
You want have to settle for mom's meatloaf.
You'll save money on food.
weaknesses: You'll probably never learn to cook.
Sometimes you don't really want the food to appear, especially not in class.
I don't know what else but maybe you'll think of something.

name: Chest Beams
description: A person with this power can shoot concussive beams originating from their upper chest. In addition, the user can control when to fire their chest beam and it will not fire at the wrong times. However, when used it will break the chest region of their clothes. Luckily this power also gives the user's chest some sort of invulnerability so that you don't need armor to protect it.
summary: The ability to shoot concussive beams from your chest
strengths: Surprise Factor
Can do it at close range via a hug
Can be fired repeatedly
weaknesses: Will expose your chest for the world to see
Con number 1 can be worse if you are female or worse for male as well

name: Saikazane Ryu
description: The demonic dragon Saikazane is capable of perceiving all knowledge of the universe, from insects to questions of faith. He can also fire destructive beams from his eyes which disintegrate anything it makes contact with. The kanji tattoos on your forearms allow you to invoke this mysterious being to do your bidding. Saikazane can also transfer a small portion of his powers to the summoner, such as energy projection, flight, immense strength, lightning quick speed, and superior durability.
summary: The ability to summon a demonic dragon.
strengths: Defeat feeble enemies with ease.
Disintegrate your desired targets.
Gain knowledge of the universe.
weaknesses: You are still vulnerable.
A dangerous ability to utilize around civilians.

name: Punisphere
description: You can lift up the opponent and trap them in a micro-electromagnetic dimension of your creation. Watch as your foe gets electrocuted several times inside; then you close your fist, crushing the dimensional orb which causes raw energy to give your foe the final large shock and dealing huge damage, probably killing them.
summary: The ability to trap & shock your enemy in a tiny orb.
strengths: Could give your enemy a squeezing shock.
weaknesses: Some people are protected against trapping through their powers

name: Moon Blade 9th Lighting Yellow
description: Blade for controlling light and lightning. Looks like a golden blade with blue marks on the hild and bottom bart of the blade.
summary: The ability to summon the 9th Moon Blade
strengths: Can summon lightning bolts.
Can control light in any variation such as making someone invisible by bending the light around them
Or by blinding someone with light or absence of it.
weaknesses: Light manipulation has no effect on blind people and light illusions are cancelled by true-sight.

name: Red Sun Beams
description: With this power you can shoot red sun radiation from your hands. Red Sun Radiation can turn Kryptonians into normal humans. Depending on how much red sun radiation you shoot them with the longer they lose their powers for. The red sun radiation also burns non Kryptonians but doesn't make them lose their powers.
summary: The ability to shoot red sun radiation from your hands
strengths: You can turn Kryptonians into normal humans
You can burn non Kryptonians
weaknesses: As long as they're near a yellow sun you cannot make the Kryptonians lose their powers permanently
It only burns non Kryptonians

name: Aura Of Purification
description: Anyone who stands in the aura of someone with this power will be purified of evil and become more inclined to do acts of good.
summary: The ability to purify others of evil by keeping them in one's aura
strengths: Artifacts and places can also be purified by keeping them in your aura.
weaknesses: Anything that leaves your aura can still become (more) evil.

name: Car Of Dacia
description: (This car can travel through dimensions) this car looks like the dacia logan 2. The colour of the car is what you want it to be. The car uses nuclear energy.
summary: The ability to posses a car that can travel through dimensions
strengths: Travel through dimensions
Meet different peaple
You get to choose what colour you want for your car
weaknesses: You cant time travel (no con negation)
This car uses nuclear energy (you've been warned )
If you lose the car you will be lost in the dimension forever

name: Anti Matter Breath
description: Depending on the amount of air that you choose to exhale, this power can dispose of everything within its reach. It can destroy an army that is the size of the entire army of China, the Persian Empire, and the Roman Empire combined; over 1,000-fold.
summary: The ability to exhale a beam of Anti-matter at will.
strengths: In the most extreme case, when the whole world is your enemy, this comes in handy.
You posses a certain energy that makes you Immune to the Anti-Matter explosion.
weaknesses: Think of all of your loved ones.
You also destroy a lot of the natural resources that you depend on to eat and drink.
Every being would want you to leave their planet. You would have a hard time making friends.

name: Tripler Du Canon De Venin
description: Manifest a cannon, two for each arm and one for the back, charge energy and then fire a huge amount of power to cause huge damage
summary: The ability to produce triple cannons that release powerful energy
strengths: Destroy any enemy in its path
Extremely fast power blasts
Can reduce a mountain to rubble
weaknesses: Can't be used more than once a day
Huge consumption for amount of power used
Has to sleep for 24 hours after eating huge consumption

name: Dissolvilcation
description: Your fingers are glowing with a bright greenish aura and you shoot a beam at your opponent's head that causes it to explode into bloody pieces while their body will dissolve into a puddle of dark yellow or lime-ish goo.
summary: The ability to shoot beams from your fingertips that cause your foe's head to explode and their bodies to melt.
strengths: A kind of a weird fatality.
weaknesses: Totally gross.

name: Death Eater's Hunger
description: Death Eaters being what they are, mock & sneer upon the very existence of life in this realm. For them, only death & decay, which are most often than not inevitable, are the only absolute truth that nature must eventually obey & submit to. Through this ability they are able to ultimately cast insult to life & to anyone who futilely attempt to keep it by inexplicably transforming that ability to live or its energy into the absolute existence of death in the form of dark viscous blob-orb of death.
summary: The ability to transmute life energy into bite sized orbs of death.
strengths: You do not simply end life; you distort, corrupt, & reverse its existence and function.
These death orbs can be consumed by a death eater or manipulated into other useful forms.
Very pleasing for anyone who thrives on the death of other's.
weaknesses: The meaning, essence, and existence of life is ultimately altered.
Immortality

name: Induced Radioactivity
description:
A person with Induced Radioactivity can generate dangerous radiation in massive amounts for a variety of effects including:
*Radiation poisoning
*Radiation burns
*An EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse)
*Heating objects
*And finally, a dangerous atomic blast similar to an Atomic Bomb
summary: The ability to generate harmful radiation
strengths: Extremely powerful
Can stop an army
Only limited by imagination and will
weaknesses: Always emitting some radiation
No peaceful uses
Easy to fatally injure or kill

name: Mr.Sunshine
description: This power assures that the user will always be bright and sunshiny, even if their mood and their actions reflect just the opposite. One with this ability is constantly surrounded by a warm glow that is reminiscent of sunlight, and can be used as such. In the user's presence, plants get nutrients and grow slightly faster (but never out of control); you cast a glow in the dark, can withstand being sunburned, can withstand intense cold, and (perhaps the best part) you can turn it on/off anytime.
summary: The ability to be constantly surrounded by a warm glow of sunlight
strengths: You constantly radiate warm and comforting sunshine (never too hot or too bright)
All the properties of sunlight (help plants grow, give off heat/light, resist temperature extremes)
When developed, can turn it off and on at will
weaknesses: This power was changed from its original idea (hope the author doesn't mind)
Those who can absorb or manipulate solar energy tend to be a pain
Somtimes the heat, light and radiation you give off depends on your emotions (burn stuff by mistake)

name: Human Magnet
description: This power allows you to become magnetized. You can attract or repel metal objects. This will become very useful if people are trying to shoot you. Although in it's early stages, this power is uncontrollable, but with time, you'll be able to master it.
summary: The ability to be magnetized
strengths: Repell bullets
Never have to reach for a fork or other utensil
Be able to pick up change
weaknesses: Bad when in cutlery store
Bad in video cassete store
In early stages, uncontrollable

name: Human E.O.
description: Ever wanted a portable electric plug? Well, now you have one. With this power, you can generate an electrical outlet from any part of your body to supply energy to your many devices. Electricity is infinite and comes from a special dimension. You can change the shape of the electrical outlet to fit any plug.
summary: The ability to create electrical outlets from any part of your body
strengths: Very convenient
No electricity bill
weaknesses: Can only make an outlet as big as your body
Someone can kidnap you to use you as their infinite power source
If someone pours water on you then you will get shocked but only if you have an outlet on

name: The Dark Side Of The Force
description: The Force is an energy field created by all living things, that surrounds and penetrates living beings and binds the galaxy together. Sith can harness its Dark Side to do nearly anything from telekinesis to shooting lightning to conquering the galaxy. The ability to connect with the Force is based upon the concentration of Midi-chlorians in your cells.
summary: The ability to harness emotions such as anger, jealousy, fear, and hate for nearly infinite uses.
strengths: You can choke people with your mind
Your eyes turn yellow
You rule over a vast army of clones and planet-destroying superweapons
weaknesses: You don't get to choose what color lightsaber you have, because red is the only one ominous enough
Multiple of these will occur to you: mutilation, betrayal, defeat by a kid, and painful death
There's only 2 of you against the entire Jedi Order, and at one of you has to die in this movie

name: Surgical
description: With this power the user can channel pure energy into the form of any surgical tool. The energy can be drawn from the surroundings or from the user. The energy can be reshaped into any surgical tool and will act as the tool does. More than one tool can be formed at a time. The energies can be used to create chemicals to be used in surgeries but the user can not control the chemicals once they are created.
summary: The ability to create surgical tools out of pure energy.
strengths: Create surgical tools and chemicals anywhere.
Save people's lives.
Use surgical tools to "operate" on your enemies.
weaknesses: Need knowledge of how to perform surgery.
Can not control chemicals after they are produced.
Operations may not go as you wish.

name: Exploding Limb Technique
description: Ability to make objects explode when stricken by your limbs. When striking objects with your hands, feet, legs, knees, elbow, fingers and even your head it sends large amount of kinetic energy through the object in which causes rapid and violent explosion; all depending on how hard you can strike an object. The harder you hit the bigger the explosion. The technique can be used for defensive or offensive use, which takes training.
summary: The ability to make objects explode when stricken by your limbs.
strengths: Able to make objects explode and the ability heightens when in adrenaline rush.
Used as/or for self defense.
Can control the kinetic force either through thought or power of the mind.
weaknesses: When in a emotional state of conflict it can be an unwanted accident waiting to happen.
Debris from explosion can harm you, well depending on what the debris consist of.
Needing extensive training/knowledge on knowing how to focus the energy and use it.

name: Holy Power: The Tormentor
description: With this power you can "activate" the Tormentor mode. You gain a powerful energy kimono and the powers of the Tormentor. While using the tormentor you get Hallucinization, Superhuman Senses and Super Speed Class Omega. You also become able to use all the other Tormentor ability's. To acquire the Tormentor you must send a killer that repented from his crimes to hell, even if he is good now.
summary: The ability to use the powers of The Tormentor, the third Path of Light.
strengths: Allows you to use all the next Godlike powers of The Tormentor.
Makes you so fast that you become able to reach the light speed.
Allows you to use the Torment Claws, who brings punishment to all the ones who should suffer.
weaknesses: Hard to get, Tormentors are considered black sheep's by the other enlightened.
Need Six Paths of Light.
Another Enlightened can kill you.

name: Evil Impulse
description: When the user places their hand against the victim's chest, they can suck out all the evil and release that in the form of an energy beam. Once mastered, you can amplify their evil until it becomes too much to handle. This will cause the victim to explode.
summary: The ability to gather energy from evil and use it in an attack.
strengths: You can easily defeat super villains.
Every living being has even a little bit of evil in them.
weaknesses: This power recoils every time it is used.
You can accidentally use this power against yourself.

name: Blessing Of Hestia
description: Hestia is the Greek goddess of home and family. A being with her blessing has many gifts. For one, they always have a home, temporary or permenant. Meaning they always will have someplace to stay, rest and eat. Also whenevery they're at home, any injuries they have will heal rapidly and they will start to regain their energy. And when at home, they can conjure food for themselves and visitors. The user can also induce loving family like feelings in anyone they have eye-contact with.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Hestia
strengths: Always having a home.
Healing and food conjuring
Good family-like feelings
weaknesses: Can only conjure so much food.
Can't control where your homes will be(they will always be nearby, though)

name: Fusion Dance!
description: A more universal fusion dance, of the sorts. Where two beings, of any race, shape and size, can align their energy signatures and combine them by performing a mode of body movements. The result of the dance is that of one individual, standing in an aura of electricity and force, whose level of power has been heightened several-fold, and who possesses mixed physical and mental traits of both fusees. Life across the multiverse would never see this coming.
summary: The ability to merge two bodies together into a single, superior entity.
strengths: Create an awesome, super-cool name for the fusees; like, Matalex (Matt + Alex).
Become the most powerful being in existence with knowledge of martial arts.
Destroy anyone who threatens to destroy you or the Earth, or take over the Galaxy!
weaknesses: Users must know how to and perform the dance without flaw.
The new body may be difficult to handle, and might harbor intolerable mannerisms.
The fusion lasts just about 30 minutes -- sucks!

name: Energy Mimicry
description: One with the ability of Energy Mimicry is capable of mimicking the energy in one's surroundings. They can also mimic other empowered humans' abilities by successfully replicating their energy. However, when one mimics the energy of an empowered human or a normal human they take their ability strength as well. So they are just as experienced as the user they mimic from.
summary: The ability to mimic the energy that is in one vicinity, whether being heat-related, magnetic, solar, or kinetic.
strengths: The advantage that one has in battle is immense since they can take their enemies' power
With training, one can wield all forms of energy.
One can also learn to master the natural elements
weaknesses: Can only mimic nearby energies.
Can't master mimicked abilities from others past their proficiency.

name: Eye Beam Holes
description: Ever wanted to make someone's head disappear? Just stare at them and concentrate. Turn 'em into swiss cheese. This can be done to any substance. You can control the hole's size, but its maximum diameter can only be as big as the distance you are from the object, and its maximum depth is half that distance. You can unmake a hole by staring at it again, so you can pass through walls and stop followers. This can be used for spying, though it is not as discreet as X-Ray Vision.
summary: The ability to stare holes through objects
strengths: Very Dangerous
Holes don't have to be permanent
Works on any substance
weaknesses: Limit to size of holes
Only works if you can see the target
Not the best way to spy

name: Negative Neutral Blasts
description: There are these machines/powers that take away superpowers called "neutralizers." Villains just love using these to make the hero "a normal person". Ironically this power only works if you have been neutralized; now you can create powerful blasts of energy to project at your enemy, fly or create a shield to protect yourself and others. All powers are neutralized, except this one; if this is your only power, nothing is neutralized.
summary: The ability to create powerful blasts of energy from your body when your powers are neutralized.
strengths: This power is made to activate if you have been neutralized
Send the blasts from your feet to fly
Stop the blasts a few feet from you to create a shield
weaknesses: Only works if you have been neutralized
Sucks if this is your only power

name: Wind Up Punch (Kinetic)
description: A person with this power has the ability to charge up kinetic energy in their fists by "winding up" their arms-spinning. Also, the user can store this energy for any time they want until they punch something. When they punch something, they transfer all the charged kinetic energy into the attack. The target will either get blasted away or have a gaping hole. The energy is transferred without Newton's Third Law, so there is no recoil and the user's arms do not break due to the opposing force.
summary: The ability to charge up your fists with kinetic energy by winding up
strengths: You can store unlimited amount of energy by winding up
Your arm does not break from the recoil or Newton's Third Law
You can combine this with superspeed to wind up faster or with multiple arms to get more hits
weaknesses: It takes time to store energy
If you spin too fast, you might dislocate something
You only get one shot since it will most likely blast your target away or kill in one shot

name: Backfire
description: You can send out a glowing yellow-green ball of energy which will disable the opponent's ability to fire projectiles and/or shoot beams from their eyes, but your foe can still try to attack you.
summary: The ability to disable the opponent's ability to use projectiles.
strengths: Can temporarily nullify the person's ability to fire projectiles.
weaknesses: The opponent can still hurt you.

name: Myth Power: Eyes Of Aidos
description: Aidos (Aedos, Aischyne, Aeschyne) in Greek myth, was the goddess of respect, modesty, shame and humility. As such, channeling her allows one to exude an aura commanding the utmost respect from neutrals; they will seek one's opinion on everything, regardless of one's actual knowledge or experience. In addition, simply by asking nicely, subjects will follow any compulsion (within their capacity). One can even fill subjects with such great shame, humiliation or shyness that they cannot function.

strengths: People respect you and value your opinion even over the EXPERTS (and defend you faithfully)
Simply by asking nicely, people will do whatever you want (in their physical/mental capacity)
Fill foes with such a great feeling of shame or humiliation that they become depressed

Only psychically perceive, communicate with and summon one's role models at the higher levels (NCN)

name: Delete This Armageddon Torpedo

weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

description: The twin devils are a pair of sais that are forged from mercury & scandium. Further, they can send forth blasts of necrobolts which can only destroy any opponent that is evil. They will be sent  all the way to the underworld.

strengths: Awesome sais
Darkness manipulation
weaknesses: Only works on evil beings

strengths: Artifacts and places can also be corrupted by keeping them in your aura.
weaknesses: Anything that leaves your aura can still be purified.

name: Jobber Aura
description: A person with this power can make anyone purposely lose to them in any activity once. When used the other person somehow wants to lose to you for some given reason and they will forget the reason after they lose. This will always work--however this can only work against someone in a given activity only once.
summary: The ability to make people want to lose to you
strengths: Beat people way stronger than you
Impress your friends
weaknesses: Can only work against anyone or anything once for a given activity

name: Ivory Axe
description: The ivory axe is a mystical materialistic weapon to be used for blunt damage and is nearly indestructible. Can Swirl it about 440 degrees around you, converting into a blunt force melee weapon or as a throwing weapon. It can also fire an energy blast of fire or ice. It could also manipulate magnetic fields, allowing the user to deflect incoming gunfire back at attackers.
summary: The ability to use it to unleash a powerful swing & slice your enemies.
strengths: It is immune to evil acts if that means it can't crave blood.
It can cut through any substance.
weaknesses: None.

name: Iron Tiger Armor
description: The person with this suit of armor will be able to fly, shoot focused laser beams, missiles as well as use the armor's advance H. U. D. Interface to hack into security systems, scan for life signs, give tactical suggestions as well as give a status report on armor's statuts and prevent the suit's system from being hacked into. The suit is colored black and yellow.
summary: The ability to wear an near indestructible tiger themed armor
strengths: Able to combat most threats
Cannot be hacked
weaknesses: Susceptible to EMP blast
Replacement parts might be hard to come by

name: Reaper   Sickles
description: The reaper sickles are totally razor sharp with chains linking between them, you can throw it at your foe and it will home in onto your opponent and it will spin around you, charge it and fire energy waves & dispense electric stun shocks from the blades. Can even grab the opponent and hit them onto the sickles which pull through them.
summary: The ability to use it to fire slashing projectiles.
strengths: Those have incredible range and last a longer time.
weaknesses: None.

name: Astral Law: Gungnir's Point
description: The user is allowed to take out Gungnir, Odin's supreme spear. The spear generates a gauntlet of the hand on which it's held. It has the ability to fire gravitational beams that have the effect the user wants (e. G. The user can fire a gravotational beam that crushes the opponent to the ground using gravity or sends them up into the atmosphere where they die of lack of oxygen. The user can also fire small pods that have the same effects. Gungnir can also act as a compass for places or for energy
summary: The ability to take out Odin's mythical spear Gungnir from the MantraPlane
strengths: One has probably the best compass in the world.
One can transfer the effects of hieghtened or lessens gravity onto the opponent
One can have a portable powerful weapon
weaknesses: The gravitational effects wear of after some time
Since all of the user's mantra is on controlling Gungnir, the user is quite weak to physical attacks
Gungnir is a long range weapon and is not nearly as good in close range

name: Omnidroid Summon
description: With this power you can summon the Omnidroid from The Incredibles. The Omnidroid is under your complete control and can shoot lasers, crush things, cut things in half, turn into a ball and run over things and more.

It is under your complete control
weaknesses: It can be destroyed (it's hard but it can be done)

name: Enhancement: Electrifying
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it electrifies the power's physical part. This power requires no source of power to keep going. If stolen, it will permanently electrify the power it is attached to. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.

name: Hollow Mask
description: This ability lets you grow a hollow mask on your face at any time by storing energy and moving your hand in front of your face. Your mask will appear however you want it to look. When you release your mask you get the ability of one of the arrancar from Bleach which is a permanent effect for the mask. So for example your mask would be called Hollow Mask- Luppi or Hollow Mask- Ulquiorra

Increased strength, edurance, and speed

name: Lightning Thumbs
description: With this ability, you have nearly unbreakable thumbs that can move ten times faster than normal.

strengths: You have faster thumbs that are more resistant.
weaknesses: Only good for videogames.

name: Pearly Whites Of Doom
description: If you have this power, you will find a natural but translucent coating on your teeth that is connected to your nervous system. It destroys leftover food and bacteria and absorbs light every time you open your mouth. You can control this coating and make it release the light it absorbed. You can also control the way in which it's released, and how much. It could be mere radiance to help you see in the dark, or a full blast of photons in the form of a 'laser'.

strengths: Naturally clean teeth which emit light when you want them to!
Brighten a dark room, or blow it to bits.
Surprise your dentist!
weaknesses: This light runs out the more you use it, so you have to recharge it sometimes.
People might get digusted that you won't clean your teeth (even if you don't have to).

name: Moon Blade 6th:Crystal Diamond
description: The Moon Blade is transparent but can still be seen. Made of unbreakable diamond. The main use is that if you focus any type of laser-like power (or other powers) on it, you can make the blade act like a prism and reflect the power all around you, without harming you.
summary: The ability to create a Moon Blade made of diamond.
strengths: With training, it's possible to focus power reflection on a specific target.
Great for using that laser vision on a crowd of people at the same time.
Unbreakable, and can cut nearly all things.
weaknesses: Before you learn to focus the rays, you better not use it while allies are near you.

name: Black Hole Whips
description: You're a master of black hole whips (dark energy/dark matter whips). Use them on your enemies as regular whips or synchronize various black holes to become near undefeatable. Wrap yourself in them & you are immune to the vacuum of space & even black hole effects. They can be used to swing around large areas
summary: The ability to wield symbiotic black hole whips
strengths: They absorb or bend light, allowing you to blend in with shadows or become invisible
You are their host so no one can lift them but you (density shifting)
weaknesses: You are still normal

You might end up destroying Earth and this solar system

name: Thunder Skulls
